maps.title: SB classes 2026 · Class 02 · The Visa to Vaikuntha

nodeData.note: SB 3.15.13 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. Brahma begins to answer the frightened demigods by describing the spiritual world, starting with how the four Kumaras crossed every covering of the universe and entered Vaikuntha. Prabhu explains that they could do so because they were amala-atma, free of the mentality of being lord and enjoyer, while we suffer like visitors overstaying a visa in a temporary world. The visa home, he says, is purity gained through hearing, chanting, remembering and worship. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
The demigods come to Brahma because a darkness spreading through the universe has stopped all their work, and they suspect it comes from Diti's embryo.

🎙 Prabhu at 03:37 (auto-transcript): “We are hearing the response of Lord Brahma to the demigods. The demigods approached Lord Brahma because they saw a darkness spreading throughout the entire universe. and they went to Lord Brahma to find out the source of this darkness because that darkness had stopped their…”

To relieve their anxiety, Brahma first describes the spiritual world, before telling the back story of Diti's sons Hiranyaksha and Hiranyakashipu. Simply hearing of that world frees one from anxiety.

🎙 Prabhu at 04:37 (auto-transcript): “And therefore, Lord Brahma began narrating a description of the spiritual world. Just by hearing about the spiritual world, one can become free from anxieties. The demigods, they were under anxiety. So much darkness everywhere, all their work had stopped. To relieve their…”

To describe it he must have seen it. Born into total darkness, Brahma heard two words, understood he should perform austerity, and after long austerities the Lord, pleased, shook his hand — and Brahma experienced the spiritual world.

🎙 Prabhu at 05:51 (auto-transcript): “When did Lord Brahma see the spiritual world? For him to describe the spiritual world means he had to have had experience of the spiritual world. So we read from the previous canto Lord Brahma when he was born he was also surrounded by darkness just like this darkness that's…”
Brahma tells how his first sons, the four Kumaras, travelled through the universe and, being free of contamination, entered the spiritual sky and its Vaikuntha planets.

Asked to populate the universe, the Kumaras refused. By yoga they stopped their bodies at five years old, though they were the first-born of creation.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:58 (auto-transcript): “But these four sons they refused. They disobeyed the order of Brahma. They said no we are not going to do this. And they were highly elevated in yoga. And so by their yogic power, they stopped their bodies from aging. So they stopped the body when it was just five years old.…”

Being lighter than the lightest, they travelled everywhere. The universe has coverings of earth, water, fire, air and ether, each far thicker than the last, yet the Kumaras needed no drill or spaceship to pass through. — “They didn't drill through these coverings”

🎙 Prabhu at 09:21 (auto-transcript): “This material universe has many layers of covering. So there is the universe itself and then the covering that comes on top is earth. And then seven times thicker than the diameter of the universe is this covering of earth. and seven times thicker than the covering of earth…”

They crossed by yogic power and because they were amala-atma — pure. Nations send rovers to Mars and the moon, but no machine reaches the spiritual world, because it too is pure.

🎙 Prabhu at 10:29 (auto-transcript): “and number two, because they were Amala Atmana. Amala Atmana means, Mala means contamination. And Amala means no contamination, pure. Because they were completely pure, they could transport themselves from the material universe to the spiritual universe. It is not possible.…”

children.topic: Not a shower and fresh clothes
children.note:
The contamination is not on the body but in our mentality and consciousness. — “no this is not the contamination we are talking about”

🎙 Prabhu at 11:47 (auto-transcript): “I'll take a nice shower put on fresh clothes and then I can go no this is not the contamination we are talking about The contamination is of our mentality, our consciousness. Shra Prabhupada explains in the introduction to the Bhagavad Gita that our material existence here is…”

Citing Srila Prabhupada's introduction to the Gita, Prabhu says material life is defined by these two ideas. The Kumaras were free of them; as long as we want to enjoy, we stay where that desire can be fulfilled.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:10 (auto-transcript): “Shra Prabhupada explains in the introduction to the Bhagavad Gita that our material existence here is defined by two types of consciousness. I am the Lord and I am the enjoyer. The Kumaras, they were free from this. They were free from this consciousness of I am the Lord and…”

We want to enjoy and be lords here, but this world is not eternal. A visa to America lasts only so many days; overstay it and you live in anxiety, as with the ICE raids Prabhu mentions.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:17 (auto-transcript): “But there is a problem which Lord Brahma is speaking about over here. The spiritual world is Vaikuntha. This world is Kuntha, the opposite. So although we want to live here, to enjoy here, to be the Lord here, there is a problem and that problem is this world is not eternal…”

Our nature is eternal, full of knowledge and bliss, but here we receive a body that is temporary, ignorant and without bliss, and we try to make it permanent.

🎙 Prabhu at 15:03 (auto-transcript): “We come here, we are eternal. We seek eternity. Our nature is sat, chit, ananda. Eternal, full of knowledge and blissful. But when we come here, we get a body. Because this is the material world, we have to stay in a body. We come here, we get a body and that body is asat, it…”

Prabhu shares a reflection he heard: apart from a mother's milk, nothing good comes out of the body, and without skin people would run away — yet illusion makes us spend so much time caring for it.

🎙 Prabhu at 15:46 (auto-transcript): “I was hearing recently, if you sit and you introspect and you analyze, if you look at our bodies, there is nothing good that comes out of the body. Male body, nothing good at all. Female body, milk comes out, that is okay. But anything else apart from that, nothing good. We…”

children.topic: A place of misery, and temporary
children.note:
Krishna says every planet up to Brahmaloka is a place of misery and repeated birth. Even if someone found a cure for the misery, it would not last.

🎙 Prabhu at 17:30 (auto-transcript): “Lord Krishna tells us in the Gita that from the planet of the demigods Brahma Lok down to the lowest planet all are places of misery and what is this misery? this misery is punar janma this misery is repeated birth repeated birth so in the previous verse”

Defending is our greatest concern because this is not our place. Huge industries research how to stop birth, death, old age and disease — all because we are anxious. — “We are foreigners here.”

🎙 Prabhu at 19:19 (auto-transcript): “We are always thinking, we are always under anxiety because it's not our place. We are visitors here. We are foreigners here. But we are trying to become natives. That is the problem. We are actually natives of the spiritual world. We belong in the spiritual world. The world…”

The Kumaras were in pure goodness, not ordinary goodness. Material goodness is overtaken in turn by passion and ignorance, and knowledge brings a sense of superiority that binds again, so we must transcend all three modes.

🎙 Prabhu at 20:52 (auto-transcript): “and so therefore the Kumaras they could go to the spiritual world because they were amala atmana they were free from this contamination and illusion that we are these bodies, I am the lord I am the enjoyer, they were free from all this, they were situated in the mode of…”

Brahma says the Vaikunthas are worshipped by every planet. All other places share the same anxieties.

🎙 Prabhu at 23:13 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada is mentioning These anxieties are birth, death, old age disease. And not only that, the Vaikuntha planets are worshippable by all planets in this world. Just like we hear many times people dream of the America dream, isn't it? Everyone wants to go to America…”

People dream of America as safe and secure, then hear of random shootings and cars driven into crowds; no place in this world is safe.

🎙 Prabhu at 23:27 (auto-transcript): “Just like we hear many times people dream of the America dream, isn't it? Everyone wants to go to America and stay in America because it's such a great country. So much facility, so much enjoyment, so much security, etc., etc. I don't know how much of that is true. I have…”

Indra watches who performs horse sacrifices; when someone nears a hundred, alarms go off and he intervenes, as he will with Prithu and Bali Maharaj. Heaven also ends when piety runs out. — “You can't have my job, he will stop it.”

🎙 Prabhu at 24:51 (auto-transcript): “Demigods are also always anxious. We find from the scriptures we hear, Lord Indra, he is always monitoring who is performing sacrifices. Who is applying for my job? Because if you do 100 sacrifices, ashrameda yagya, then you get the post of Indra. So he is always monitoring.…”

Like owning an iPhone but wanting the newest one, the demigods have far more enjoyment than us yet still aspire for Vaikuntha.

🎙 Prabhu at 26:40 (auto-transcript): “We know this phenomenon We may have an iPhone But it is not the latest iPhone We want the latest one Not the one that we have Similarly demigods although they have all enjoyment much much greater than here Still they aspire for Vaikuntha because the enjoyment in Vaikuntha…”

children.topic: Why Brahma describes it in detail
children.note:
Hearing the description creates a desire to go and reduces our desire to stay. Even demigods want human birth to hear about Vaikuntha.

🎙 Prabhu at 27:07 (auto-transcript): “And we will hear Lord Brahma giving the description of Vaikuntha planets When we hear these descriptions we also desire to go That is why the description is there Otherwise Lord Brahma could have said yes okay the spiritual world is there no description and just mentioned…”

The way to Vaikuntha is a human body engaged in devotional service, which clears the heart's contamination. — “That visa is become Amal Atmana.”

🎙 Prabhu at 28:00 (auto-transcript): “The way to Vaikuntha is when one gets a human form and engages in devotional service When we do devotional service then we are on the path of becoming Amala Atmanas Devotional service clears the contamination which is there By changing the holy names of the Lord all that is…”

Serving the master of the senses with our senses removes the layers we carry from birth — man or woman, student, spouse, parent, boss or servant — and we learn we are Krishna's eternal servants.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:58 (auto-transcript): “Sarvopadi vinirmuktam tatparatvena nirmanam Rishikena Rishikesha Sevanam Bhaktir Uccate When we engage our senses in the service of the master of the senses, then what happens all the upadis all the designations all the contamination the layers that we carry right from birth…”

Krishna describes the material world as an upside-down banyan tree cut with knowledge — knowledge of the spiritual world, of who we are and what we do there.

🎙 Prabhu at 30:33 (auto-transcript): “therefore Lord Krishna tells us engage in the process of devotional service tatapadam tat parimargitavyam yasmingatana nivartantibhuya tameva chadyam purusham prapadya yata prabhirtir prasita purani Lord Krishna is giving the description of the material world as a great…”

Hearing about Krishna's pastimes, qualities, form and abode cleanses the heart. Mahaprabhu came to give the medicine of the holy name for the disease of material existence.

🎙 Prabhu at 31:49 (auto-transcript): “Sutta Goswami tells us that when we hear about the transcendental plastines of Lord Krishna about his qualities and his form and his abode then all that is dirty in the heart gets cleansed. There is a whole scientific process. How to become Amalatmana? And it begins with…”

Even in paradise we spend time cleaning dust; there, everything is touchstone, with wish-fulfilling trees and goddesses of fortune serving Krishna. Remembering such descriptions is part of the process.

🎙 Prabhu at 32:49 (auto-transcript): “Yes, this is the spiritual world. Where there is no dust. Even if we are living in the most beautiful place on this planet, there will be dust. and you'd have to spend a considerable amount of time of your day just trying to clean the dust. You may be living in paradise, but…”

Brahma gives a sneak peek: the residents of Vaikuntha are thousands of times more beautiful than the demigods — whose Apsaras would floor anyone here — yet their only activity is serving the Lord.

🎙 Prabhu at 33:50 (auto-transcript): “So when we hear, we chant, we remember and then we also, archanam, we worship, we engage in worship. Just like the residents of Vaikuntha, we will hear further Lord Brahma saying that. Just like the residents of Vaikuntha, their only work, not even work, their only activity…”

The eternal soul, in eternal relation with the eternal Lord in His eternal abode — and the eternal activity that takes us there is bhakti.

🎙 Prabhu at 35:22 (auto-transcript): “And so that is the message of the Bhagavad Gita that we are Sanatan Jivas. We are eternal living entities. Lord Krishna is also Sanatan as Ishwara. He is always the Supreme Lord. And then he lives in his own abode which is known as Sanatan Dharma, the eternal abode of the…”

Prabhu asks who wants to stay here forever, then who wants to go to the spiritual world; some answer 'maybe'. To enter we must become pure through hearing, chanting, remembering and worship.

🎙 Prabhu at 36:27 (auto-transcript): “And if we want to enter and with a show of hands, who wants to stay here in this material world forever and ever? Okay, good. Everyone's awake. Just checking. Who wants to enter into the spiritual world? Some people are like, maybe. We are still seeing. Yes, if we want to…”

Questions and comments at the end of class.

🎙 Prabhu at 37:08 (auto-transcript): “If there are any questions or comments. Hare Krishna Prabhu, how do you go? I am just curious that the Joghambra is in this instance where So the question is, when were the Kumaras stopped from travelling in Vaikuntha? That will come up in the next shlokas. I didn't speak on…”

children.topic: Q1 · Where were the Kumaras stopped?
children.note:
A devotee asks when the Kumaras were stopped in Vaikuntha.

🎙 Prabhu at 37:19 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Prabhu, how do you go? I am just curious that the Joghambra is in this instance where So the question is, when were the Kumaras stopped from travelling in Vaikuntha? That will come up in the next shlokas. I didn't speak on that because it will come up in the next…”

That comes in the next verses: they passed six gates and were stopped at the seventh, where an altercation followed.

🎙 Prabhu at 37:54 (auto-transcript): “So they were able to enter and in the spiritual world, in the Vaikunthas, there are many many gates so it is mentioned that Lord Brahma is saying they were able to go through 6 gates they were stopped on the 7th gate and then a whole altercation happened and we will hear as…”

children.topic: Q2 · Should we have no desires?
children.note:
A partly inaudible question about desire, which Prabhu restates as: what is the Lord's desire?

🎙 Prabhu at 38:34 (auto-transcript): “with entirely other desires such as God is a normal as a mind we don't have the desire but we just what are the desires what is the desire of the Lord is that the question the desire of the Lord is for the Sanatan Jeeva to come to the Sanatan Dham and engage in Sanatan Dharma…”

The Lord wants the eternal soul to come home and serve. A stone or an AI has no desire, but life is defined by desire; we cannot drop it, only change it from pleasing ourselves to pleasing Krishna. — “Desireless means stone.”

🎙 Prabhu at 39:43 (auto-transcript): “We cannot be desireless. Desireless means stone. Stone has no desire. You keep a stone here, it will stay here a thousand years if nobody moves it. It doesn't desire anything. It's not living. But every living entity by nature, inherent, or we can say that the quality of life…”

What does the Lord mean when He says penances are His heart and soul?

🎙 Prabhu at 41:31 (auto-transcript): “When the Lord says that penances are my heart and soul, what does he mean by that? He means by that that when one engages in performing penances and austerities to please the Supreme Lord He becomes very very happy The reason that the Lord gave Darshan to Brahma was because…”

Austerity done to please Him makes Him very happy, as Brahma's did. Today that means the four regulative principles, sixteen rounds and eating only Krishna prasadam.

🎙 Prabhu at 42:00 (auto-transcript): “He means by that that when one engages in performing penances and austerities to please the Supreme Lord He becomes very very happy The reason that the Lord gave Darshan to Brahma was because Lord Brahma pleased the Lord by his austerities So if we want to please the Lord we…”

children.topic: Q4 · How did yogis reach Vaikuntha?
children.note:
How could mystic yogis such as the Kumaras or Durvasa enter Vaikuntha?

🎙 Prabhu at 43:13 (auto-transcript): “The mystical yogis how did they enter Vaikuntha? Again as is mentioned here in this verse the Kumaras they were Amalatmana they were free from all material desires. They are not devotees yet. They will become devotees, we will read, they will become devotees later on. But,…”

children.topic: They entered but could not stay
children.note:
The Kumaras, not yet devotees, entered because they had no desire for sense gratification. Impersonalists may reach the Brahman effulgence but fall back without devotional service; Durvasa reached Vishnu yet the Sudarshana chakra still chased him.

🎙 Prabhu at 43:20 (auto-transcript): “Again as is mentioned here in this verse the Kumaras they were Amalatmana they were free from all material desires. They are not devotees yet. They will become devotees, we will read, they will become devotees later on. But, because they were free from desire for personal…”

Ordinarily no one can enter; the Lord makes exceptions for actors in His pastimes to show the glory of devotional service, as with Durvasa and Ambarisha. The normal way is Dhruva's: devotion, by which the Lord grants His audience.

🎙 Prabhu at 45:48 (auto-transcript): “So they entered, yes. They entered, I said they entered Vaikuntha but they couldn't stay. Ordinaryly, no one can do that. When the Lord wants to perform some pastimes, he gives some exceptions to few of his actors in that pastime. Just like the Kumaras were given an…”

nodeData.note: SB 1.14.43 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. Seeing Arjuna's sorrow, Yudhishthira keeps questioning him, and Prabhu shows how the Pandavas' grief reveals an attachment to Krishna far deeper than worldly ties. Yudhishthira's question about eating before feeding the old and the young opens a picture of saintly rule, where brahmanas, cows, women, children and elders were protected so everyone could fulfil the purpose of life. Prabhu contrasts this with today's selfishness and presents Krishna consciousness, and prasadam distribution, as the way back to that culture. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Arjuna returns after seven months in Dwarka with a sad, dejected face; as we ask 'what's wrong?' when we see such a face, Yudhishthira questions him.

🎙 Prabhu at 02:51 (auto-transcript): “Yudhishthir Maharaj is asking Arjuna questions Arjuna having spent seven months in Dwaraka and returned to Hastinapur and seeing Arjuna's face Arjuna had a face that wasn't showing any joy and so seeing the sad dejected face of Arjuna Yudhishthir Maharaj is asking what…”

Narada had told Yudhishthira to prepare: when Krishna departs, the Pandavas too should get ready to leave. The omens told him the time had come, yet it was very hard to process.

🎙 Prabhu at 04:12 (auto-transcript): “Narad Muni in the previous chapter when he had met Yudhishthira Maharaj he said you prepare yourselves and when the time comes you will know that Lord Krishna has gone and then you should also prepare to leave. So Yudhishthira Maharaj, observing these various omens in the…”

The chapter is named for Krishna's disappearance, yet it never describes it; devotees so attached to Him do not speak of it. We hear only their reactions. — “They can't think of a moment without Lord Krishna.”

🎙 Prabhu at 04:54 (auto-transcript): “So here the chapter is called The Disappearance of Lord Krishna. but we have not heard anything about the disappearance of Lord Krishna. What are we hearing? We are hearing Yudhishthira Maharaj first speaking to his younger brother Bhima, noting to Bhima all the various…”

We only get glimpses of what the Pandavas felt; to understand fully we would need their attachment to Krishna. For them there is now no reason to stay on earth.

🎙 Prabhu at 06:35 (auto-transcript): “So this chapter and the next chapter is when Arjuna will speak and he speaks with very much heaviness in the heart we cannot imagine such a situation we are only getting glimpses of it from what Vyasadeva has written for us in the Srimad Bhagatam what Suta Goswami is…”

When one spouse dies the other often follows soon. Doctors reassure even very sick patients, because without the will to live even the best treatment fails.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:19 (auto-transcript): “Many times we hear of incidences wherein there is a couple and either the husband or the wife passes away and within a very short time, the other partner passes also away because of the intense attachment they shared. So there are documented instances for this. There is so…”

When Mahaprabhu ended His pastimes, Gadadhara Pandit, about the same age, was so attached that he became old overnight. — “he became old overnight.”

🎙 Prabhu at 08:43 (auto-transcript): “We hear in the Chaitanya Charitamrita, Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu concluded his pastimes. And when Gadadhar Pandit heard about this, he was also in a similar situation. It is described that Gadadhar Pandit became old overnight. Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, he was on this earth for…”

Material attachment is mostly to looks, money or comfort; very few are attached to the person. The Pandavas' intense attachment brings intense separation.

🎙 Prabhu at 09:48 (auto-transcript): “We may have an experience similar, but attachments in this material world are not as intense as attachments to Lord Krishna. In the material world, attachments are based on external factors. Someone likes how someone else looks like or someone likes that person because they…”

children.topic: He wants to hear it from Arjuna
children.note:
Yudhishthira's heart is not ready; he has guessed the truth but wants Arjuna to confirm it. Pure devotees love Krishna more than their own lives, and He loves them the same way. — “The pure devotees, they love Krishna more than they love their own lives.”

🎙 Prabhu at 10:51 (auto-transcript): “How can we live without Krishna? Yudhishthira Maharaj is asking that to Arjuna. The heart is not ready to accept that Lord Krishna is no longer there. They know, Yudhishthira Maharaj could figure out, yes, this is all because most probably Lord Krishna is not there but he…”

While questioning Arjuna, Yudhishthira also highlights Vedic culture. Saintly kings — Yudhishthira, Parikshit, Lord Rama — shared certain elements in their rule.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:07 (auto-transcript): “But in the course of asking all these questions, Yudhishthira Maharaj is also highlighting various aspects of Vedic culture and society. We heard in the earlier chapters about the rule of Maharaj Yudhishthir And Vedic rule, the kings that were saintly They had certain…”

First the brahmanas and the cows; then women, children and the elderly, and in Yudhishthira's case also the sick and invalid.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:04 (auto-transcript): “What are these elements? Number one, protection of the brahmanas. Number two, protection of the cows. This is like non-negotiable. And then it expands further protection of the women, the children and the old, the elderly. And Yudhishthira Maharaj, Siddhartha Goswami is…”

Today we see the opposite: exploitation instead of protection. Then, failing to protect these people was unpardonable.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:46 (auto-transcript): “Whereas what we see now is totally the opposite. Instead of protection, there is exploitation. So therefore Yudhishthira Maharaj is asking these questions Because during that time, to fail to protect these elements of society was unpardonable. Here he is saying, Akshamam,…”
Yudhishthira asks whether Arjuna has done something unpardonable, such as eating before feeding the elders and children.

Householders were defined by charity: they fed children, elders, brahmanas and the sick first, and went out to call three times for anyone hungry. Mendicants took a little grain from a few homes, and an uninvited guest was treated like a demigod, so no one went hungry.

🎙 Prabhu at 15:06 (auto-transcript): “Krishna Prabhupada is mentioning that the householder would go out on the street and ask three times is anybody hungry please come we have some prasadam and each and every householder was doing this so therefore in the society there was no one who would go hungry we hear how…”

If a householder called out like that now, the whole village would come, find too little, rob the house and beat the family. Even feeding known guests daily is hard when everyone is struggling. — “the whole village will come”

🎙 Prabhu at 16:23 (auto-transcript): “we can't do this today if a householder goes outside and says is there anybody hungry please come the whole village will come and then they don't get enough food and then they will rob the entire house and beat the householder and beat his family members why did you call us…”

Those who do have means often say they worked hard and others should do the same. Yudhishthira's government and Vedic culture were not like that.

🎙 Prabhu at 17:53 (auto-transcript): “this that the general tendency is that I took this, whatever I have is because of my blood and sweat. If you want something like this, you also work. You'll also get. Do hard work. But Yiddish Shira Maharaj's government wasn't like that. Vedic culture wasn't like that. Vedic…”

Each group was protected for a purpose, not just for its own sake.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:16 (auto-transcript): “But Yiddish Shira Maharaj's government wasn't like that. Vedic culture wasn't like that. Vedic culture, first of all, gave preference to the Brahmanas. The Brahmanas were never working and the Brahmanas were never worried, oh, will we get to eat today? Sometimes there was…”

Maintained by the king and by householders with gifts of cows, land and grain, brahmanas never worried about food and focused on teaching the goal of human life.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:16 (auto-transcript): “But Yiddish Shira Maharaj's government wasn't like that. Vedic culture wasn't like that. Vedic culture, first of all, gave preference to the Brahmanas. The Brahmanas were never working and the Brahmanas were never worried, oh, will we get to eat today? Sometimes there was…”

Ghee is needed for sacrifice and milk sustains everyone and develops the fine brain tissue for higher understanding. In this spiritual communism no living being goes hungry — unlike today's 'that's your problem, not mine'.

🎙 Prabhu at 21:01 (auto-transcript): “And therefore they would protect the cows Because the cows would give milk Would give ghee And these are essential for maintaining Brahminical culture The ghee is needed for performing sacrifices that the Brahmanas would do The milk is needed to sustain everyone in society…”

Protected women raise good children, and so culture is maintained. Children are taught from early on not to waste the human form like animals.

🎙 Prabhu at 21:29 (auto-transcript): “So, apart from these two, then Yudhishthir Maharaj would ensure that the women are also protected because if the women are protected, they give good progeny. If there is good progeny, culture can be maintained. And so the women also are protected, not exploited. They were…”

Elders are protected so they can prepare for death, the final exam. If they must hunt for food, shelter and medicine, how can they think of Krishna? Many societies now send them to homes as a burden.

🎙 Prabhu at 22:48 (auto-transcript): “world. The elderly were also given protection so that they can prepare themselves for the final exam, death. We look at today's society, all these elements are struggling. Or worse, they are being exploited. In some African cultures, when a person is elderly, they say, no,…”

Dhritarashtra had tried to kill Yudhishthira and made the Pandavas suffer, yet after the war Yudhishthira cared for him as the family elder. — “he never held a grudge that”

🎙 Prabhu at 23:53 (auto-transcript): “He is showing by his own personal example How he took care of the elderly Dhritarashtra wanted to kill Yudhishthir Maharaj the same Dhritarashtra after the war Yudhishthira Maharaj was taking care of him as an elderly member of the family he never held a grudge that oh this…”

Today animals and trees are not protected.

🎙 Prabhu at 25:33 (auto-transcript): “And today we see what is being protected. Who is being protected? The animals are not being protected. Trees are not being protected. So many trees are being cut down every single day. For what? For making buildings. we need a factory to come here chop down the entire forest…”

Forests are cleared for buildings and factories, and then we are surprised the weather changes; people told Prabhu Nairobi used to be pleasant. There must be repercussions.

🎙 Prabhu at 25:43 (auto-transcript): “Trees are not being protected. So many trees are being cut down every single day. For what? For making buildings. we need a factory to come here chop down the entire forest and then we all become surprised oh why is it becoming hotter some people were telling me last week…”

Beyond material facilities, Yudhishthira's real protection was the chance to use human life to come to Krishna. Brahmanas taught in their homes so everyone could hear the scriptures and go back to Godhead.

🎙 Prabhu at 26:23 (auto-transcript): “Yudhishthira Maharaj's entire kingdom everyone was free from anxiety because Yudhishthir Maharaj made sure that the purpose of human life that is put in the forefront. Yes, everyone was given their material facilities but the real protection was that they are able to utilize…”

Saintly kings knew Krishna maintains everyone and they were only caretakers, making His provisions available.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:15 (auto-transcript): “Yudhishthira Maharaj understood that the real maintainer of everyone is Lord Krishna. Nityo nityanam chetanas chetananam Eko bahunam yo vidadattikaman Lord Krishna is the one who is providing. Lord Krishna is the one who is maintaining. So the saintly kings like Yudhishthira…”

Srila Prabhupada's example: the mother has no milk until the child is born, then it is there. Whoever the Lord sends here, their food is arranged.

🎙 Prabhu at 29:01 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada gives the example of a child being born as soon as the child is born there is milk in the breast of the mother before that there was no milk but as soon as the child is born immediately the milk is there so Lord Krishna has made provisions for every living…”

Srila Prabhupada's father left flour on the floor of his cloth shop at closing so the rats would eat it and not the cloth. Even rats and snakes were cared for. — “they eat the flour”

🎙 Prabhu at 29:39 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada mentioned in his childhood about his father his father had a textile shop there were clothes inside the shop and so closing time his father used to leave some flour on the floor for the rats so Srila Prabhupada asked why are we doing this? no they eat the…”

children.topic: Why take a life for the tongue?
children.note:
Srila Prabhupada strongly taught non-violence. If human life is only eating, sleeping, mating and defending like the animals, by what standard do we decide an animal need not live? Human life differs only in its chance for devotion.

🎙 Prabhu at 30:41 (auto-transcript): “And that is why Śrīla Prabhupāda was such a strong proponent of ahimsa, non-violence. He used to challenge people, why for the sake of your tongue you are taking the life of an animal? You can do without. What gives one person the right to take another person's life or…”

Today good manners surprise people and bad behaviour is expected, because brahmanas and leaders have failed to teach what human life is for.

🎙 Prabhu at 32:20 (auto-transcript): “nowadays there's no culture someone does something cultural and it's like wow where did you come from otherwise it's expected nobody has any culture nobody has any etiquette nobody has any manners so-called manners there are always so many articles and clips on the internet…”

Srila Prabhupada founded ISKCON to teach the point of human life. A body without a head is directionless; we provide the head. — “we give the head.”

🎙 Prabhu at 33:38 (auto-transcript): “He said, our society is a society of Brahmanas. If a body does not have a head, then that body is directionless. It doesn't know where to go, what to do. So Srila Prabhupada said, we give the head. We teach. We are hearing how Yudhishthir Maharaj's rule was. What was the main…”

A century ago people still had extended selfishness — the rich built schools, hospitals and wells in their villages. Now it is 'my money, only for me', not even for family or partner.

🎙 Prabhu at 34:46 (auto-transcript): “So, even if we look 100 years back, society was having extended selfishness. People would think about their families, people would make sure that the village or the tribe or the clan, they are all well done, settled. Those who are rich, they would go to their village. If…”

Krishna consciousness lifts us from selfishness to wanting everyone's highest good — the Vaishnava's compassion. Without Srila Prabhupada we would still fight over resources that are the Lord's. As we progress spiritually, Yudhishthira's sensitivities come automatically.

🎙 Prabhu at 36:03 (auto-transcript): “for Krishna consciousness we see Krishna consciousness means we come out from that selfish nature and come to the selfless platform where we are not just worried about ourselves but we are making sure trying that everyone can get the highest benefit this is the compassion of…”

Questions and comments at the end of class.

🎙 Prabhu at 38:00 (auto-transcript): “If there are any questions or comments. Yes, Lavanga Prabhu.”

children.topic: Q1 · Who still calls the hungry?
children.note:
Lavanga Prabhu asks whether there is anywhere householders still go out asking three times if anyone is hungry.

🎙 Prabhu at 38:47 (auto-transcript): “So, Lavanga Prabhu is asking, is there anywhere where householders are calling people, going out on the street and asking three times is anyone hungry please come do you have plans of going to those places or yeah I want to see an example the example is our temple everywhere…”

Every ISKCON temple does this through Food for Life, which the questioner himself directs. Srila Prabhupada asked that no one within ten miles of a temple go hungry — and we give not just food but Krishna's mercy.

🎙 Prabhu at 39:06 (auto-transcript): “I want to see an example the example is our temple everywhere there is an ISKCON temple we are doing the same we understand Krishna is the one who is giving everyone and so we have this program called Food for Life and you are the director for Food for Life So you know,…”

children.topic: Q2 · Beyond moralism, a dog-eat-dog world?
children.note:
Arjuna was told to rise above mundane morality, yet society is dog-eat-dog; how do we understand this?

🎙 Prabhu at 41:21 (auto-transcript): “So his question is that Arjuna was told to go beyond mundane moralism and the way the society is there, it's dog-eat-dog. So how do we understand all this? Arjuna was told, yes, you rise above the Vedas which deal mainly with the three modes of material nature, but then he is…”

Rising above the Vedas' modes means coming to devotional service, whose base is brahminical culture, as a building needs a foundation. In devotional service good qualities come automatically.

🎙 Prabhu at 41:40 (auto-transcript): “Arjuna was told, yes, you rise above the Vedas which deal mainly with the three modes of material nature, but then he is told to come to the platform of devotional service and devotional service means there is the base which is Brahminical culture you cannot have devotional…”

children.topic: The Vedas say what, culture says how
children.note:
Our culture is centred on Krishna, so its chaos need not touch us; when we engage the outside world, our duty is to teach how humans should live.

🎙 Prabhu at 42:54 (auto-transcript): “See, one thing is the Vedas that tell us what to do. But how to do it is the culture. So we have a culture. And that culture is centered around Krishna. So the chaos of the outside world, if we keep ourselves in the world of Krishna, then we are not affected by the chaos of…”

Rukhma Prabhu recalls that even under Covid restrictions devotees kept cooking and distributing prasadam, as they do wherever disaster strikes.

🎙 Prabhu at 43:40 (auto-transcript): “Yes, Rukhma Prabhu is mentioning that during covid we had so many restrictions on going out and preparing food and still following all”

nodeData.note: SB 10.3.9–10 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. On Janmashtami Prabhu explains why we speak of Krishna's appearance rather than His birth: we are forced to take birth, while He chooses everything, like the sun rising at will. He then tells the story from Kamsa's wedding-day rage to the midnight appearance and Vasudeva's journey to Gokul. The lesson is Vasudeva and Devaki's surrender: service to Krishna comes before every other obligation, and devotees request rather than demand. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Today is Krishna's appearance day. Prabhu asks the difference: birthdays are ours, appearance days are His.

🎙 Prabhu at 03:53 (auto-transcript): “So, as we all know, today is a very auspicious day. Today is the appearance day of Lord Krishna. We say appearance day, we don't say birthday. What is the difference between the two? The difference between a birthday and an appearance day. The difference is birthday we have,…”

children.topic: We are forced to take birth
children.note:
None of us chose our place, family, day, time or even name; given the choice people would pick Bezos, Zuckerberg, Musk or Ambani as parents. — “We can't choose our family.”

🎙 Prabhu at 04:40 (auto-transcript): “We have a birthday because we are forced to take birth. we come in this world and we have no choice as to which place we will take birth none of us here in the hall chose our place of birth we're forced to take place we're forced to take birth in whichever place our mothers…”

Krishna chooses His parents, day, time and place. Appearance means there is choice; He is under no force.

🎙 Prabhu at 06:37 (auto-transcript): “he celebrates appearance days. For the Lord it's totally the opposite. He chooses his parents, he chooses the day, he chooses the time, he chooses the place. He's not under any force. that is why we say the lord appears and is not born appearance means there is choice just…”

No one can order the sun to rise late after a late night. And there are not 365 suns a year — the same sun returns, as the same Lord comes, performs pastimes and moves on, while we take different bodies.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:11 (auto-transcript): “just like the sun the sun appears in the sky we cannot command the sun to appear at a particular time like oh last night i had a late night so today make sure sun rises at 8 a.m no sun will rise according to its own desire. Nobody can tell the sun, oh, today we feel like…”

Understanding the divine secret of His appearance and activities ends one's own cycle of repeated birth, as Krishna promises in the Gita.

🎙 Prabhu at 08:57 (auto-transcript): “so therefore we are bound but the lord he is free so when we say janmash me we say the door the day the Lord appeared and we will see how he appeared knowing this understanding the divine secret about the Lord's appearance frees us from our cycle of birth and death therefore…”

At Vasudeva and Devaki's wedding, Kamsa, who loved Devaki dearly, insisted on driving their chariot himself — like the decorated car that takes a couple from the venue.

🎙 Prabhu at 10:00 (auto-transcript): “that when Vasudeva was getting married, Devaki was going to be his wife and as the marriage ceremony ended the wife usually leaves her father's house to go to the husband's house and so devaki her cousin brother was kamsa and kamsa loved devaki dearly although they were…”

A voice from the sky called him a fool and said Devaki's eighth child would kill him. At once he drew his sword and seized Devaki by the hair.

🎙 Prabhu at 11:48 (auto-transcript): “proceeding towards Vasudev's house there was a sound in the sky some words were spoken and those words were Kamsa you are such a fool in Kamsa you can imagine he is there all happy driving his sister and suddenly there is someone speaking to you but you can't see who they are…”

children.topic: Why wait for the first child?
children.note:
Stopped by Vasudeva, Kamsa reasoned that with no Devaki there would be no child.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:13 (auto-transcript): “stopped Kamsa and said what are you doing Kamsa said didn't you hear it was clear the eighth child of devaki will kill me so i am intelligent why should i even wait for the first one let me kill devaki now only because no devaki no child this is demoniac mentality in any…”

children.topic: Love while we get what we want
children.note:
Prabhu calls this demoniac mentality: a relationship is fine until something disturbs it, then 'I don't know you'. Hiranyakashipu likewise was ready to kill five-year-old Prahlada for worshipping Vishnu.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:45 (auto-transcript): “in any relationship as long as we are getting what we want the relationship is okay and as soon as there is some disturbance in that relationship, then it's like, I don't know you. You're nobody to me. As soon as there is a disturbance. Kamsa showed this in his own life. Up…”

Vasudeva pleaded: how can you kill your sister on her wedding day, when she has no child yet? A king should protect those dependent on him.

🎙 Prabhu at 15:39 (auto-transcript): “So Vasudev told Kamsa, listen, what are you doing? How can you kill your sister on her wedding day? You don't even want to wait. As soon as you heard, you just immediately want to kill. And the voice was clear that the eighth child of Devaki will kill you. She has not even…”

Vasudeva promised to bring every child to Kamsa, and Kamsa agreed because he knew Vasudeva always kept his word.

🎙 Prabhu at 16:39 (auto-transcript): “Akhil Devki. So then Vasudev, he told Kamsa, you don't worry, spare your sister for today and if we do have children, I will bring each and every child to you. Then you can do whatever you want. And so Kamsa agreed. Why did he agree? Because he knew Vasudev is not a Kali Yuga…”

Today we want a recording, a photo or a lawyer's contract, because people say something in the morning and deny it by afternoon. — “In Kali Yuga, the word is the last thing we trust.”

🎙 Prabhu at 17:32 (auto-transcript): “In Kali Yuga, the word is the last thing we trust. Isn't it? Someone says, no, I'll do this. No, no, let's have a recording. Let's have a picture. Let's have some proof that you said this. let's you know go to the lawyers and have a contract drawn up because we can't trust…”

children.topic: Kamsa trusted him; not the reverse
children.note:
When Vasudeva brought his first son, Kamsa let him take the boy home. Kamsa could trust Vasudeva's word, but Vasudeva could never trust Kamsa's.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:26 (auto-transcript): “And in due course of time, indeed, there was a child born to Devaki, the first son. And Vasudev took the first son to Kamsa. And Kamsa was very happy. He said, oh yes, see, I knew Vasudev cannot go back on his word. And you see, he's brought the first son to me. So Kamsa…”

Narada asked Kamsa how he knew which child counted as eighth, and showed him a flower: which petal is first? Kamsa jailed the couple and killed the first son.

🎙 Prabhu at 19:52 (auto-transcript): “and the demigods were watching all this and they said what is Kamsa doing why did he let Vasudev go so immediately Naradvuni came there to Kamsa and he told Kamsa see you were told the 8th child of Devaki will kill you and you are assuming that eighth means it's in sequential…”

Devaki watched her own cousin kill six children. The seventh was moved by Krishna's arrangement to Rohini's womb as Balarama, and Kamsa counted it a miscarriage.

🎙 Prabhu at 22:05 (auto-transcript): “and kamasa took the first child killed the first child and you can imagine the trauma deviki is there in front of her her firstborn child is being killed by her cousin her own brother and this happened six consecutive times every time Kamsa heard that Devaki is pregnant he…”

Meditating on Krishna, Vasudeva first felt Him in his consciousness; then, as an acharya describes, Krishna leapt from Vasudeva's heart into Devaki's through his instructions to her. He was not conceived like an ordinary child.

🎙 Prabhu at 23:22 (auto-transcript): “and then time came again Devaki had Lord Krishna in her womb and Shukadeva Goswami mentions that Vasudev because he is a devotee he was meditating on Lord Krishna and so first of all Lord Krishna appeared in his consciousness Vasudev could feel in his consciousness oh here is…”

Since He is everywhere, His being in Devaki's womb is not so amazing; what is new is that she could now experience Him there.

🎙 Prabhu at 24:27 (auto-transcript): “so he wasn't conceived like how ordinary children are conceived and then our Acharya say Lord Krishna was already there he is everywhere So for him to appear in the womb of Devaki is not a very big amazing thing. He was already there. But now Devaki could experience Lord…”

Devaki glowed, but in Kamsa's prison her radiance was hidden. Demigods came to pray, eager for His pastimes, while Kamsa planned to kill the eighth child and live forever. — “just like a fire is covered by a pot.”

🎙 Prabhu at 24:56 (auto-transcript): “And demigods came because they could also understand. Shukadeva Goswami mentions Devaki was glowing. But her effulgence was covered just like a fire is covered by a pot. inside the pot the fire is effulgent but the pot is covering the fire so the same way the lord was in the…”
At midnight under the Rohini star, Vasudeva sees the newborn Lord in His four-armed form, richly adorned, the colour of a monsoon cloud.

Devaki knew He was the Supreme Lord who could finish Kamsa with a snap of His fingers, yet her motherly affection and fear made her beg Him to hide His form.

🎙 Prabhu at 27:02 (auto-transcript): “and Devaki she prays she says my dear Lord, my dear son please hide yourself all my other children never had four arms you came with four arms if Kamsa sees he will kill you immediately please hide yourself her maternal affection took over it is not that Devaki never knew…”

Famous for keeping his word, Vasudeva had brought six children to Kamsa, but for Krishna he chose to break that promise. He did not sit on a moral high ground.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:08 (auto-transcript): “Vasudev also he had taken all he had said I will take every single child of mine to Kamsa he took 6 but this one 8th one he said no I will not take this child Vasudev was known for keeping his promise Kamsa also knew this But when it came to Krishna, Vasudev said, this…”

Yudhishthira never lied, so only he could make Drona believe Ashvatthama was dead. Bhima killed an elephant of that name; Yudhishthira hesitated, attached to truthfulness, and his chariot, which never touched the earth, came down.

🎙 Prabhu at 29:12 (auto-transcript): “we find with the case of Yudhishthir Maharaj Yudhishthir Maharaj was also known never having to have spoken a lie you know this Yudhishthir Maharaj had never spoken a lie even Duryodhan respected Yudhishthir Maharaj because of that he said no Yudhishthir Maharaj if he says…”

When it comes to service, other obligations are set aside. The gopis let no family member or circumstance come between them and Krishna, so they are His highest devotees.

🎙 Prabhu at 33:04 (auto-transcript): “This is the glory of a devotee and the highest devotee of Lord Krishna are the gopis. The gopis never let any obligation, any circumstance come before them and their service to Krishna. no family member no other obstacles they allowed to come between them and Krishna…”

If Krishna came today to take us, how many would ask for time to clear an EMI, raise the children or finish business? Pure devotees go immediately. — “some people say can you give me a few lifetimes”

🎙 Prabhu at 33:44 (auto-transcript): “if Lord Krishna was to come today to us and tell us please come with me let's go I have come to take you how many of us will be ready or how many of us will say Lord Krishna I still have a EMI that I need to clear and I still have children that I need to take care of and I…”

Krishna becomes a baby and tells Vasudeva to take Him to Gokul. Neither parent argues or asks to keep Him a little longer; Devaki herself urges Vasudeva to go.

🎙 Prabhu at 34:37 (auto-transcript): “here is lord krishna devaki is praying to him please hide this form and as soon as he changes into a baby form two-armed form very cute baby devaki is looking at him he's in her laps and then lord krishna says take me to go cool look at vasudev and devaki look at the quality…”

Chained in a prison far from Gokul, Vasudeva did not ask how. As he lifted Krishna the shackles and doors opened and the guards slept. — “Most of the time, guards are sleeping.”

🎙 Prabhu at 36:12 (auto-transcript): “Imagine both of them, Vasudeva and Devaki, they are in shackles. They are inside a prison house in Kamsa's prison, far from Gokul, no car, no chariot, no horses, nothing. Vasudev didn't ask Lord Krishna, how am I supposed to take you to Gokul? How am I supposed to get out of…”

In the storm Vasudeva did not hesitate; Balarama as Ananta spread His hoods over them, and the Yamuna parted to make a path.

🎙 Prabhu at 37:21 (auto-transcript): “And as he came out of the prison house, it was a storm outside. There was so much rain. Vasudev didn't see, oh so much rain, how am I supposed to take Krishna now? No, he surrendered to Krishna's will. He said, Krishna wants to go, I'll have to take him. And he started…”

In Nanda's house he laid Krishna beside the sleeping Yashoda, took her baby, and walked back — expecting nothing from Krishna, not even release.

🎙 Prabhu at 38:36 (auto-transcript): “There he found Yashodama. She was sleeping. and next to her there was a child so he put krishna down he picked up the other child and walked right back this is the surrender of vasudev no expectation from krishna now that krishna now you're born oh now you can kill kamsa and…”

Back in prison the chains closed again and the baby girl's cry woke the guards. Devaki fought Kamsa with all her strength: he had killed her children, but she would not let Yashoda suffer the same.

🎙 Prabhu at 39:48 (auto-transcript): “imprisoned even after lord krishna went to goku because kamsa when he heard that devaki had given birth to an eighth child and when vasudev came with that child back from yashoda's house when he came back to the prison house all the shackles were put back the doors were…”

No longer trusting the demigods after Narada's hint, Kamsa seized the girl, but she slipped away and appeared with eight arms and weapons, calling him a fool a second time: his killer was already born.

🎙 Prabhu at 41:29 (auto-transcript): “but Kamsa being Kamsa he said eighth child demigods you know can't be trusted I already got a hint from Narada Muni eighth child could be anyone so what if they even got the gender wrong I can't trust the demigods anymore Kamsa grabbed hold of the child the girl and he tried…”

Even then Kamsa kept them imprisoned. This was not cruelty from Krishna but service from Vasudeva and Devaki; His pastime also needed a reason to bring Him to Mathura. — “that service on Vasudeva and Deviki's part.”

🎙 Prabhu at 42:52 (auto-transcript): “so Vasudev he is following Krishna's orders Krishna told him take me to go cool and i will come he didn't ask how many years later they were actually imprisoned for whole 11 years after krishna's birth 11 more years they spent in kamsa's jail now we may be thinking how can…”

A pure devotee says: Krishna, whatever You desire is my desire.

🎙 Prabhu at 44:41 (auto-transcript): “They sacrificed their own personal desires. For a devotee, there is nothing like a personal desire. A pure devotee says, Krishna, whatever you desire, that is my desire. This is what Lord Krishna came to show here on this earth with all his devotees. How they are serving, how…”

May we have desires? Yes — we pray to Krishna 'if You wish', and remain His devotees whether or not the prayer is granted. — “Devotees request, they don't demand.”

🎙 Prabhu at 45:21 (auto-transcript): “This is the standard of pure devotional service. Does it mean we should not have any desires? Of course, we should. We can pray to Krishna, but we request Krishna, not demand from Krishna. Devotees request, they don't demand. That's the difference. So we can go to Krishna and…”

On Janmashtami we can meditate on Vasudeva and Devaki, who asked nothing — another eleven years in jail, Krishna away from them, no problem — and pray for the same strength.

🎙 Prabhu at 46:15 (auto-transcript): “see Vasudev and Devaki their devotional service was so pure and so high they never had any requirements on their side they just said Krishna you order we will do staying in jail for another 11 years no problem taking you to Gokul no problem you not being here with us no…”

children.topic: He gives what the order needs
children.note:
Krishna gave Vasudeva not only the order but every facility to carry it out; whatever He asks of us, He will give the strength for.

🎙 Prabhu at 47:09 (auto-transcript): “us to do so in summary we saw lord krishna is not forced to appear and we also saw that the devotees of lord krishna they don't let any obstacle come between them and krishna lord Krishna gave Vasudev the orders but he also gave Vasudev all the facilities to carry out the…”

nodeData.note: SB 10.41.50–51 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. On Janmashtami Prabhu describes Krishna's unsurpassed beauty and His freedom from work and need, then follows Krishna and Balarama into Mathura to the florist Sudama, who garlands them and their friends. Through Vidura's banana peels, Trivakra, the fruit seller and the poor brahmana Sudama, he shows that Krishna wants only our best, offered with love and not as a transaction. Sudama's prayer for unshakable devotion, friendship with devotees and transcendental compassion becomes the prayer for the day. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
We celebrate the Lord's appearance on earth some five thousand years ago, but for practising devotees Janmashtami comes daily.

🎙 Prabhu at 00:31 (auto-transcript): “today is a very very auspicious day for all of us devotees we celebrate the appearance of the lord on this earthly planet some sources say 5300 and some 20 years ago the lord was here and so for devotees janmashmi actually comes every day janmashmi is not just one day in a…”

Janmashtami is also the day the Lord appears in the heart, so every day He should appear in ours. — “every day should be Janmashmi.”

🎙 Prabhu at 01:10 (auto-transcript): “because not only is Janmashmi the day when Lord appeared on this earth but for devotees Janmashmi is the day when the Lord appears in the heart. So every day the Lord should appear in our hearts and so every day should be Janmashmi. Here we are reading about how Lord Krishna…”

Of Krishna's unlimited qualities the acharyas list sixty-four; one is His beauty, which Brahma describes: flute, peacock feather, the colour of a rain cloud, yellow dhoti.

🎙 Prabhu at 01:37 (auto-transcript): “Here we are reading about how Lord Krishna and Balaram entered Mathuram. Our Acharyas, they tell us, Lord Krishna has unlimited qualities. You cannot put a number to the qualities that Lord Krishna has. But 64 of them have been listed by our Acharyas. And among the 64 of…”

Srila Prabhupada told of a tourist in India searching for the supreme God. Shiva held a trident, Durga many weapons, Rama a bow — all must be working; but Krishna held only a flute, so the tourist concluded He was supreme.

🎙 Prabhu at 02:56 (auto-transcript): “shala prabhapad once told about a inquisitive tourist who had gone to india and there he wanted to know who is the supreme God because usually people have the notion that if you're an Indian you worship many gods and so this tourist also was thinking they have so many gods…”

In the Gita Krishna says He has nothing He must do. We work because we have desires to fulfil.

🎙 Prabhu at 05:34 (auto-transcript): “yes Lord Krishna has no work he tells in the Bhagavad Gita I don't perform any activities nor do I need to perform any activities see we all work because we need a desire to be fulfilled. Someone has a desire to enjoy a nice meal, whatever that meal may be. Then simply by…”

To eat one rasagulla you need milk, fire and sugar — so cows, land, grass, sugarcane and processing. Millions of desires create countless industries. — “Just simple desire to eat one Rasagulla.”

🎙 Prabhu at 06:46 (auto-transcript): “I always give the example of a rashagula. Someone has a desire to eat a nice rashagula. For that desire to happen he needs to have milk because rashagulas are made from milk. He needs to have fire. He needs to have sugar. For milk then means he needs to have a cow and the cow…”

Krishna is atmarama and satyakama: complete, His every wish already fulfilled by His energies. We desire too, being His parts, but need help from everyone to fulfil ours.

🎙 Prabhu at 08:10 (auto-transcript): “So we can say, oh, even a stone has no desire. But that's not what Krishna is. Lord Krishna, he is so self-satisfied, he is Atmarama, that he doesn't require anything. He is completely complete. He is complete. He can fulfill his own desires. Another name of Lord Krishna is…”

In the spiritual world you ask a tree or a surabhi cow for a rasagulla and it is there. Devotees see beyond His form to the beauty of His heart, which appreciates any small service.

🎙 Prabhu at 10:23 (auto-transcript): “And that's the nature of the spiritual world as well. Lord Brahma, before he describes the beauty of Lord Krishna, he describes the beauty of the spiritual world. Chintamani prakarasadmashu kalpavriksha. Kalpavriksha. You go to the tree in the spiritual world, And you have a…”

Krishna, Balarama and their friends, excited village boys from Vrindavan, enter the big city.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:02 (auto-transcript): “So we see here Lord Krishna and Lord Balaram, they went with their friends into Mathura. It was a big thing, they were village boys coming from Rindavan, they are going to a city, Mathura, big city. city. So, as young boys, they are very excited. You are going to a city. We…”

Asked for some fine clothes, the king's washerman shouted at the boys to go away. Krishna flicked his chin and his head came off.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:29 (auto-transcript): “And as they entered the gates, they saw a washer man there. And he was washing fine clothes. And Lord Krishna asked this washer man, Oh please, can you help us with some of these clothes? And the washer man, he started shouting. He said, Don't you know? These belong to the…”

Having seen this, a weaver called the boys and gave them all fine clothes.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:24 (auto-transcript): “And so they went a little bit further and there was a weaver there and immediately he saw what happened to the washerman he called all the boys please please come Krishna, Balaram come come all of you come and he gave them all very fine clothes yes you have come to the city…”

At the florist Sudama's shop he washed their feet, offered prayers and felt his house and family purified, asking only what service he could do.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:51 (auto-transcript): “Krishna and Balaram and their entourage they went to the house of Sudama the florist so it was a market area there was a washer man, there was a weaver florist so as they entered the house of or the shop of Sudama he welcomed them so nicely he washed their feet he offered…”
Sudama offers his best garlands to Krishna, Balarama and their companions; delighted, the two Lords offer him whatever blessing he wants.

Many think God is alone on a throne, like a judge. Krishna shows glimpses of His home: He is a person with parents, friends, pets and family, and Sudama honoured them all. — “it's between me and my God”

🎙 Prabhu at 15:42 (auto-transcript): “usually people they tend to think it's just me and God there should be nobody in between right or they even say my God it's between me and my God and there should be nobody in between nobody around also many spiritual pseudo spiritual paths, they also have this idea that God…”

Sudama came bowing down and surrendered — the same attitude Krishna asks for in the Gita when approaching a teacher.

🎙 Prabhu at 17:47 (auto-transcript): “and being satisfied with this with the service of Sudhama how was Sudhama coming in front of the Lord Pranataya Prapannaya he had offered obeisances bowing down and he had surrendered the same words Lord Krishna uses in the Gita Tadvidi Pranipatena Pariprasnena Sevaya…”

Sudama offered his finest garlands, saved for special occasions. Krishna's interest is whether we give Him our best.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:26 (auto-transcript): “Sudhama offered the best that he had. He is teaching us here, Sudhama. Lord Krishna, what is he interested in? He is interested in, are we giving our best to him? Duryodhana, just before the war had started, Lord Krishna went to Hastinapur. And so Duryodhana understood Lord…”

Duryodhana laid on a grand feast hoping Krishna would side with him, but Krishna said He goes only where there is love for Him. — “I am not interested in your opulence.”

🎙 Prabhu at 18:52 (auto-transcript): “Duryodhana, just before the war had started, Lord Krishna went to Hastinapur. And so Duryodhana understood Lord Krishna is coming. He said, oh, if Lord Krishna is favorable to me, maybe he'll fight on my side. So he arranged a big feast, 56 items preparation, huge dining hall…”

Krishna went to humble Vidura instead. In ecstasy Vidura peeled bananas, threw away the fruit and fed Him the peels, and Krishna accepted, reciprocating with his love.

🎙 Prabhu at 20:53 (auto-transcript): “Duryodhana's invitation and instead he accepted Vidura's invitation Vidura had also invited my lord please come to my house and Vidura's facilities were modest compared to Duryodhana's Duryodhana was living in a palace Vidura son of maidservant so you can Understand that…”

children.topic: A leaf, a flower, with love
children.note:
Even our best flowers are pale beside those of the spiritual world, where flowers never fade. What attracts Krishna is not the thing but whether we give our best.

🎙 Prabhu at 23:33 (auto-transcript): “he did the best he could in the spiritual world the flowers never die although Lord Krishna in the Gita he is telling us one who offers me with love and devotion a leaf, a fruit, a flower, water I will accept it but if we meditate on this what kind of flower can we offer to…”

The boys teased the hunchbacked Trivakra, but when Krishna asked for the ointment meant for Kamsa she gave it all. He stepped on her toes, lifted her up and straightened her into a beautiful woman.

🎙 Prabhu at 26:14 (auto-transcript): “Further on, when Lord Krishna leaves Sudama's house and goes further, he sees Trivrakra. Trivrakra was a lady who was bent in three places. She was hunchback. People would call her Kubja. They would make fun of her. She would walk funny. She would look funny. and so the boys…”

Like the ladies who sell fruit door to door in Nairobi, a vendor filled little Krishna's arms with fruit for the few grains left in His cupped hands. At home her empty basket was full of jewels.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:56 (auto-transcript): “there was another lady we don't I don't know if they're here in Durban right but in Nairobi you see these ladies they carry vegetables and fruits and they go house to house right and they're selling they walk with all that load and they sell it to each house here I think…”

Some wealthy visitors drop a 20 rand note in the box and keep the millions for their own plans. Sudama, Vidura and the fruit seller expected nothing back. — “That is a transaction.”

🎙 Prabhu at 33:08 (auto-transcript): “he's showing us give your best there are those people who come to the temple they're earning lots of money you know either they have a very big position in some company or they're big industrialists and when they come to krishna they remove a 20 rand note and put it in the…”

Offered a boon after Hiranyakashipu's death, Prahlada said he had never asked the Lord to come; a master who makes his servant ask is no proper master, and a servant who asks is no proper servant. — “I am not a businessman, Prahlad Maharaj tells the Lord.”

🎙 Prabhu at 35:06 (auto-transcript): “And so therefore Pradhan Maharaj taught us this. where Lord Nishingadev had killed his father Hiranyakashipu. After killing his father, Lord Nishingadev asked Prahlad Maharaj, please ask for something. And Prahlad Maharaj said, what are you asking? How can I ask you for…”

Worldly relationships are transactional: parents remind children of their sacrifices, and in the standing joke a wife won't let her husband take sannyasa until he has provided a house and a bank balance.

🎙 Prabhu at 36:43 (auto-transcript): “There's a standing joke that when a husband wants to take sannyas, he goes to the wife to ask for permission. Can I take sannyas? And the wife says, what have you done? You've not done anything yet, how can you go? And he spent whole his life taking care of the family. But…”

If it were business, 20 rand would bring 20 rand back. The fruit seller gave fruit and got jewels; input and output don't match, because Krishna doesn't do business.

🎙 Prabhu at 37:31 (auto-transcript): “See, if it was a transaction, then it means whatever we give Krishna, Krishna gives back. if I give 20 rand to Krishna Krishna will give me 20 rands worth but does he do that no the lady gave vegetables Krishna gave whole basket full of jewels if you were to look at what…”
Asked what he wants, Sudama seeks only steady bhakti, the company of devotees and a higher kind of kindness toward every being.

Without devotion we might ask to be President of the United States, or for Indra's post and rule over the three worlds. Sudama asked for none of it.

🎙 Prabhu at 38:44 (auto-transcript): “So if Sudama was a businessman, if we were in the position of Sudama and Lord Krishna says, what do you want? And we have no devotion. We say, oh yes, I'd like to be the President of the United States, please. Thank you very much. Or, you know, Indradev, can you give him a…”

Achala means unmoving, like a mountain. Sudama asks for bhakti that never shifts to anything else, whatever happens — even with nothing to eat.

🎙 Prabhu at 40:32 (auto-transcript): “and achalam bhaktim in the first line achalam bhaktim, chala means to move achala cannot move so the mountains are known as achala because mountains don't move they stand in one place come whatever they will always be there standing right as achala as a mountain so Sudhama is…”

A different Sudama, Krishna's poor brahmana friend in Dwarka, showed the same devotion.

🎙 Prabhu at 41:17 (auto-transcript): “food to eat there is another Sudama who showed this both of them their names are Sudama but this Sudama is a florist he is in Mathura and the other Sudama was in Dwarka so the other Sudama he was very poor didn't have adequate clothing adequate food he would go out to beg…”

When the children had not eaten for two days, his wife urged him to visit his friend the King of Dwarka. He agreed only to see Him, not ask, and took a little stale flat rice so as not to go empty-handed.

🎙 Prabhu at 41:44 (auto-transcript): “empty handed so the wife got on his case one day said look it's okay you can stay fasting for a few days no problem. I can also say fasting for a few. But what about the kids? They haven't eaten in two days. So Sudama told her, well, I went. Nobody gave anything. What can I…”

The guards doubted such a man could be Krishna's friend. Krishna scolded them for leaving him waiting, seated him on His throne, washed and massaged his feet, and called Himself blessed. — “Just see the love Lord Krishna has for his devotees.”

🎙 Prabhu at 44:34 (auto-transcript): “And so the guards, they approached Lord Krishna and they said there is a Sudama waiting at the gate. And Lord Krishna told the guards, you left him waiting at the gate? What's wrong with you? And Lord Krishna rushed out with the guards to receive Sudama. Just see the love…”

Krishna seized the parcel and ate two handfuls; Rukmini stopped the third, saying she had already given so much that a third would mean she herself would have to go to Sudama.

🎙 Prabhu at 47:41 (auto-transcript): “He was about to take the third one and Rukmini stopped Krishna. She said, what are you doing? Krishna said, well, he brought me some flat rice I'm eating. He said, already two morsels, you know, I've given so much to him. If you eat the third one, I will myself have to go to…”

Sudama found his shack turned into a palace and his wife adorned. He wept and prayed for the opulence to be taken away so it would not pull him from devotion.

🎙 Prabhu at 48:18 (auto-transcript): “Krishna's palace being so happy Krishna welcomed him so nicely and then when he went back to where he was staying he was confused he didn't have google maps at that time unfortunately right and so he reached there and he's like did I forget where I live because he was looking…”

Not just food for the hungry but prasadam, connecting people to their original father and home. On Janmashtami, Prabhu says, let us pray as Sudama did.

🎙 Prabhu at 50:49 (auto-transcript): “Transcendental compassion means it's not ordinary compassion. Here someone is hungry we give them food. No. Transcendental compassion means we give them prasad. We connect them to their original father Krishna. We connect them to their original home Krishna Loka. that is…”

Questions and comments at the end of class.

🎙 Prabhu at 51:46 (auto-transcript): “If there are any questions or comments, you are free to share. Yes, it's working. Yes.”

children.topic: Q1 · Is a soft life natural?
children.note:
If Krishna has desires and we are His parts, is the desire for comfort and a soft life natural?

🎙 Prabhu at 52:37 (auto-transcript): “In general, and I heard you talking about that Krishna has desires, that Krishna can fulfill his desires. And 90% of the population have that kind of desire when they want the American dream force. And so thinking that usually people, devotees, tell me that when you have…”

Desire to enjoy is natural, but in this world it is perverted. Krishna did not leave Sudama hanging: besides devotion He gave strength, long life, fame, beauty and prosperity.

🎙 Prabhu at 53:36 (auto-transcript): “yes desire having a desire is natural desire to enjoy is natural but it is a perverted desire here in this world krishna did not leave sudama the florist hanging krishna sudama we just heard what he asked for krishna right he said give me unflinching bhakti achala bhakti but…”

Our duty is to want Krishna, not the soft life without Him. Srila Prabhupada wanted only to please Krishna and received every facility for service. — “Our duty is not to desire the soft life”

🎙 Prabhu at 55:08 (auto-transcript): “So what is our duty? Our duty is not to desire the soft life minus Krishna. Our duty is to desire Krishna. Soft life will come. All the comforts everything, all facilities, everything will come. Look at our founder Acharya. He got everything. Because his desire was only, I…”
