nodeData.note: · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. On Janmashtami Prabhu recalls how Srila Prabhupada celebrated the festival alone on the Jaladuta and then in a New York storefront, and gives the one secret behind it all: to become dear to Krishna, hear about Him. Through the brahmanas' wives, Rukmini and Lord Brahma's prayer he shows that the unconquerable Lord is conquered by submissive hearing, that bhakti is receiving rather than achieving, and that hearing invites us into Krishna's eternal party. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Prabhu says no one celebrates Janmashtami like ISKCON, and all of it comes from Srila Prabhupada's compassion. He goes back to the very first celebrations outside India.

🎙 Prabhu at 02:54 (auto-transcript): “Śrīla Prabhupāda on August 13th, 1965 boarded the ship Jaladuta to go to America. After great struggle, he finally got passage on that ship. And the very first Janmarshmi celebration that Srila Prabhupada celebrated outside of India, I think the mic is a bit, the very first…”

In the middle of the ocean, with no devotees, temple or deities, Srila Prabhupada gathered Captain Pandya and the crew, spoke to them for an hour, cooked, and served prasadam at midnight.

🎙 Prabhu at 04:40 (auto-transcript): “first Janmashmi celebrations August 28th 1965 outside of India in the middle of the ocean no devotees, no temple no deities yet Janmashmi was celebrated Shala Prabhupada Shala Prabhupada on board the ship he called captain Pandya who was the ship captain and all his crew…”

children.topic: A fast in a New York storefront
children.note:
In 1966 he told his first students, who did not even know what fasting meant, that they would take nothing and read about Krishna all night. Trusting their Swamiji, they did. — “today is Janmasmi so we must all fast”

🎙 Prabhu at 05:35 (auto-transcript): “and then comes 1966 Srila Prabhupada he rented a storefront in new york and surrounded by a few early students they were not even devotees early students he sat there and he told them today is Janmasmi so we must all fast and all the students didn't even know what fasting was…”

From those humble beginnings the festival spread worldwide; other temples now copy ISKCON's way — kirtan, hearing about Krishna, prasadam and abhishek.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:00 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada opened up Janmarshmi for the whole of the world. Many places in the world never even knew what Janmarshmi was but because of Śrīla Prabhupāda now the whole world is celebrating Janmarshmi and so much so that other institutions and other temples they are…”

Prabhu names the secret Srila Prabhupada gave: hearing about Krishna is what makes us dear to Him. The rest of the class illustrates this. — “If you want to be dear to Krishna, you have to hear about Lord Krishna.”

🎙 Prabhu at 07:45 (auto-transcript): “So he gave us the secret. If you want to be dear to Krishna, you have to hear about Lord Krishna. Lord Krishna, he was performing many pastimes in Vrindavan. And those days, the villages used to be specialized. so the village that lord krishna was living in was a village full…”

Prabhu tells how wives who had never seen Krishna became attached to Him simply by hearing about Him.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:56 (auto-transcript): “Lord Krishna, he was performing many pastimes in Vrindavan. And those days, the villages used to be specialized. so the village that lord krishna was living in was a village full of coward men that was their village everyone there had only one profession to take care of cows…”

Villages were specialised — cowherd villages, brahmana villages — and traders carried news between them. Through them the brahmanas' wives heard how beautiful and naughty Krishna was, and grew attached.

🎙 Prabhu at 08:01 (auto-transcript): “And those days, the villages used to be specialized. so the village that lord krishna was living in was a village full of coward men that was their village everyone there had only one profession to take care of cows and then there were other villages as well there were…”

The cowherd boys tell Krishna they are hungry. He sends them to a nearby yajna but advises using Balarama's name, since brahmanas would refuse a cowherd boy but Balarama was known as Vasudeva's son, a kshatriya.

🎙 Prabhu at 09:21 (auto-transcript): “friends on one fine particular day the friends started telling Krishna and Balaram oh Krishna oh Balaram we are hungry please arrange some food for us Lord Krishna said we are in the middle of the forest where am i supposed to get food from no no you are the everything you…”

The boys ask in the name of both Krishna and Balarama; the brahmanas, busy with their rituals, drive them off and threaten to curse them.

🎙 Prabhu at 11:00 (auto-transcript): “The Brahmanas indeed were doing some sacrifice there and they approached the Brahmanas and they asked the brahmanas see our lords they didn't follow Krishna's advice and they said see our lords Krishna and Balaram they are hungry the brahmanas said what are we supposed to do…”

Sent to the wives instead, the boys only have to say 'Krishna and Balarama'. The wives pack all the sacrificial food and insist on bringing it themselves, eager to finally see Him and feed Him.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:11 (auto-transcript): “So the boys went and approached the wives of the brahmanas. And they just had to say Krishna and Balaram. And the brahmana wives were, what about Krishna and Balaram? Said, oh they are hungry, oh they are hungry. Wait one minute. And they went and they took all the food that…”

Krishna asks them to go home: they will not be separated from Him while they hear, remember and chant. Fearing flying pots and pans, they return to find their husbands offering obeisances and calling them greater devotees.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:31 (auto-transcript): “at the wives and they said my dear mothers please go back home and the mother said no way Krishna and Balaram said no no no this is not good you should go back home they said no we have you we have Krishna and Balaram why will we go home to what no please let us stay with you…”

Another devotee who became attached by hearing: Rukmini, princess of Vidarbha.

🎙 Prabhu at 16:12 (auto-transcript): “shelter of your lotus feet this is the beauty of hearing about lord krishna just by hearing about lord krishna we become immediately attached there was another great devotee who also heard about lord krishna just like traders would go from one village to another village the…”

A brahmana visiting Vidarbha describes Krishna's beauty, qualities and pastimes, and Rukmini resolves to marry only Him — her real superhero. When her brother Rukmi arranges her marriage to Shishupala, she refuses.

🎙 Prabhu at 16:52 (auto-transcript): “so one such brahmana was traveling to vidarba and there he was speaking to the princess her name was rukmini and the brahmana would be telling rukmini about the beauty of lord krishna about his wonderful qualities about his pastimes and rukmini hearing all this she said if i…”

children.topic: The first courier, the first secret admirer
children.note:
She sends the brahmana racing to Dwaraka with a letter. Krishna receives him with honour, but the brahmana says: read it, it's express. She writes that she knows Him though He does not know her, and gives her plan: take her outside Mother Durga's temple, or she will end her life.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:27 (auto-transcript): “can you do me a favor please can you rush with this letter that I have written to Krishna run as fast as you can to Krishna give him this letter that time Krishna was in Dwaraka please rush this letter express it was the brahmana was one of the first courier services she gave…”

children.topic: A sleepless night, no blue ticks
children.note:
Krishna leaves overnight with Daruka. Rukmini, not knowing whether the letter even arrived, cannot sleep and cannot focus on her puja, thinking only: is Krishna coming? — “It wasn't like WhatsApp, you get two blue ticks,”

🎙 Prabhu at 22:00 (auto-transcript): “And as the morning dawned, Rukmini, she didn't sleep the whole night. She was, I don't know if Krishna will accept the letter. He doesn't know me. I just wrote a letter to him. I don't know if he'll even bother to reply. So she was completely anxious. She had no idea, no…”

As kings fall off their horses at her beauty, Krishna swoops in like a lion snatching a deer from jackals — the original knight in shining armour. He came for someone He had never met, because she had heard about Him.

🎙 Prabhu at 24:26 (auto-transcript): “then I'll leave the temple compound if Krishna is not there I will kill myself at the temple door but Lord Krishna was there and Shukadeva Goswami mentions just as a lion comes and snatches a deer from in between all jackals and hainas the Lord came in swooping the original…”

children.topic: Ajita: the Lord no one conquers
children.note:
Lord Brahma calls Krishna Ajita — no one wins a fight against Him; His streak is unbroken.

🎙 Prabhu at 25:31 (auto-transcript): “lord krishna in his past times lord brahma he tells us a quality of lord krishna he says lord krishna's name is ajita ajita means no one can conquer the lord if you were to enter into a battle with the lord you will always lose lord krishna has an unbroken streak nobody has…”

A fool named Paundraka attached two artificial arms and challenged Krishna to settle who is the real Vasudeva. Dwaraka laughed; Krishna's Sudarshana made him armless, then headless.

🎙 Prabhu at 26:02 (auto-transcript): “there was one fool his name was pondrak he somehow during that time krishna's time this pondrak had the technology to make some prosthetic arms and so he made two prosthetic arms and he attached them to his shoulder and he went to challenge lord krishna he said hey Dvarkadish…”
Lord Brahma reveals how the unconquerable Lord is conquered: give up speculation and hear submissively from devotees.

People ask how a four-armed form can become a baby, because they try to squeeze Krishna into the small box of their minds. — “to fit Krishna in a box”

🎙 Prabhu at 28:20 (auto-transcript): “we can't understand with our limited mental capacity sometimes when Krishna when people hear about Lord Krishna's birth like we were discussing this morning they say how is it he came in a four-armed form and then he took a baby form this is con people devotees of Krishna…”

Our capacity is getting worse — Prabhu saw someone ask ChatGPT how to boil water. With such brains, how can we understand the Lord's appearance?

🎙 Prabhu at 29:02 (auto-transcript): “capacity is so limited and now it's getting worse. People are offloading thinking to AI. Anything, ask chat GPT. I even saw someone once, he asked chat, how do I boil water? If we have those kind of brains where we are outsourcing our thinking to AI, how can we understand the…”

children.topic: Stay where you are, but hear
children.note:
Throw away the effort to know Him by intellect; hear from those whose whole lives are dedicated to Krishna. You need not go anywhere or change anything — and Ajita becomes jita. This temple gives that chance.

🎙 Prabhu at 30:03 (auto-transcript): “then what are we supposed to do just hear submissively from who those who are already surrendered to the Lord the devotees of the Lord those who are dedicated their whole life to serving lord krishna hear from them and therefore lord brahma says you don't need to go anywhere…”

Even if Krishna does not know us, as He did not know Rukmini, He comes when we hear about Him.

🎙 Prabhu at 31:26 (auto-transcript): “Krishna. Even if Lord Krishna doesn't know us like he didn't know who Rukmini was but he will still come to save us. Lord Krishna he says one who hears about me I destroy all the dirty things in his heart. Srutha Goswami tells us this Shrinvantam Swakatha Krishna Punya…”
Suta Goswami says that Krishna in the heart removes the inauspicious things there for one eager to hear about Him.

The world teaches us to work hard and achieve; devotional service is the opposite — we receive, and must be open to receive. — “it is a process of receiving not a process of achieving”

🎙 Prabhu at 32:51 (auto-transcript): “devotional service is so wonderful it is a process of receiving not a process of achieving in this world everyone is taught to achieve work hard you will get nobody says work hard you will receive now if you want something you work hard you achieve it blood sweat and tears…”

children.topic: Open the windows to the sun
children.note:
If we shut ourselves in a dark room we cannot blame the sun. The position that lets Krishna's mercy in is simply eagerness to hear about Him.

🎙 Prabhu at 33:54 (auto-transcript): “for it just like during daytime the sun is shining brightly but if we lock ourselves in a dark room we can't blame the sun why is there no sunlight in my house well you've closed everything up to receive sunlight you need to also be in a position to have the sun come in so…”

In Srila Prabhupada's example, a ticketless rider squeezes onto the bench for a few minutes, brings friends, and soon the ticket holders are standing. Krishna does the same: hear a little and He enlarges the space and sits there.

🎙 Prabhu at 35:11 (auto-transcript): “of Indian trains, I'm sure some of you may have experienced Indian trains. Nowadays, they have very nice ones. Vande Bharat. But before Vande Bharat, it was a different situation. And people would get onto the trains, they don't have tickets. Typical. And then when people are…”

Where Krishna lives there is no work, no stress or misery — only play. When we hear and become attached, He calls us there. — “It's party all the time.”

🎙 Prabhu at 36:28 (auto-transcript): “our lives then lord krishna calls us to his eternal playground see lord krishna where he stays there is no work if we had the option that if you were given an option no work or work majority would choose no work who wants to go to work unless you're forced to So Lord Krishna,…”

Some look for happiness at the bottom of one beer bottle after another; adverts promise 'open happiness', yet the bottle stays empty of it. Krishna comes to show the real fun He has with His friends, parents and pets.

🎙 Prabhu at 37:36 (auto-transcript): “We all want enjoyment. we are all looking for enjoyment some of us find it at the bottle or bottom of the beer bottle and they keep on drinking because they they think oh this bottle didn't have maybe the next bottle will have happiness and then they drink that and then oh…”

Yashoda packs a jewelled box for Srimati Radharani. Krishna empties it, gets in himself — He is the best — and adds 'open when alone' to the message. The gopis open it, He jumps out, and they threaten to complain until He returns the gifts.

🎙 Prabhu at 38:49 (auto-transcript): “to him so one day yeshodama she was very busy packing a big box jeweled box and krishna he approached Yashodama and he asked her mother what are you doing she said no I'm busy I'm packing but I see you're putting so many nice wonderful things in this box silk clothes jewelry…”

Srila Prabhupada has given us the Bhagavad-gita As It Is, where we hear Krishna's own words and become attached to Him.

🎙 Prabhu at 43:05 (auto-transcript): “Nishala Prabhupada has given us the opportunity. He has given us the Bhagavad Gita as it is. here we hear directly from the mouth of lord krishna his words when we hear about him we understand about him from his own mouth and in this way we can be attached to him so we'd like…”

Gitas go to those who answer: how many parents did Krishna have (four), and how many cows did His father have (900,000).

🎙 Prabhu at 43:43 (auto-transcript): “right and we want to give them out to three special people i'm going to ask a question and if you know the answer you can get a gita so the first question is how many parents did lord krishna have right okay are you avinash okay please you will choose who who who really wants…”

Prabhu offers a prayer for the day: I hear, see and think of thousands of things daily; from today let my remembrance, devotion and affection for You increase, because I want to join the eternal party.

🎙 Prabhu at 45:29 (auto-transcript): “today is the appearance day of lord krishna we can pray to lord krishna lord krishna i hear so many thousands of things every day i see so many thousands of things every day and i meditate on so many thousands of things every day but from today let me increase my remembrance…”

nodeData.note: SB 3.4.2 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. From Uddhava's account of the Yadu dynasty's end, Prabhu draws the lesson of intoxication — not only by liquor but by birth, wealth, learning and beauty. Through Nalakuvara and Manigriva, Digvijaya Pandit and Indra he shows how pride blocks devotion, and through Caitanya Mahaprabhu's ecstatic kirtan he presents the real intoxication: the holy name, reached by steady sadhana and good association. In the questions he discusses karma and wealth, staying humble with money, and the 'shortcut in the shortcut'. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Uddhava tells Vidura how the Yadu dynasty was destroyed by the Lord's will, compared in the verse to bamboos catching fire by friction. Prabhu notes the Lord's pastimes always serve many purposes at once.

Meeting Uddhava at Prabhasa, Vidura asks after Krishna's family. Uddhava, coming out of deep remembrance, has narrated Vrindavan, Mathura and Dwaraka and now says neither the Lord nor His family remain on earth — Gandhari's curse, the sages' curse and the Lord's wish all came together.

🎙 Prabhu at 03:22 (auto-transcript): “Vidura on his pilgrimage happened to meet Uddhava at Prabash Shetra and knowing Uddhava to be a very very dear associate of Lord Krishna Vidura is asking Uddhava how are the Yadavas, how is Lord Krishna's family and this brought about a deep meditative remembrance in Uddhava…”

The Yadavas were demigods and Krishna's own associates, so we should not see their drunken fight as an ordinary event. Still, the lesson for us is the danger of intoxication. — “They were simply following the orders of the Lord.”

🎙 Prabhu at 06:40 (auto-transcript): “The Yadavas, they were not ordinary people. They are Krishna's family. These are demigods and Krishna's own personal associates who came in that family. And so, as Śrīla Prabhupāda is also pointing out, they were simply following orders. We should not think that how did the…”

In this world everyone is intoxicated — with wealth, strength, beauty — and such intoxication makes spiritual progress very difficult.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:40 (auto-transcript): “not just intoxication by liquor here in this material world all of us we are intoxicated someone is intoxicated with possessing a lot of wealth or possessing a lot of strength or possessing beauty there's so many types of intoxication so we see when someone has this kind of…”

Kunti names four intoxicants — high birth, wealth, learning and beauty — that keep one from approaching the Lord with feeling, because He belongs to those who own nothing but Him. With wealth comes the sense of being someone, and pride builds.

Kuvera's two sons were promoted to associates of Lord Shiva, got great wealth, and went mad with it.

🎙 Prabhu at 08:24 (auto-transcript): “difficult to make advancement on the spiritual path. The two sons of Kuvira, Manigriva and Nala Kuvira, they were promoted to being associates of Lord Shiva and because of their promotion they got a lot of wealth and they became mad because of that wealth. So as they got the…”

Drinking and frolicking with girls in heavenly gardens, they stayed naked when Narada passed, while the girls covered themselves. Narada decides to give them special mercy and tells them it is all because of their wealth.

🎙 Prabhu at 09:03 (auto-transcript): “promotion these two boys they would go and visit the gardens in the heavenly planets and they would be surrounded by girls and they would be drinking and they would be enjoying with the girls in the gardens and one fine day Narad Muni out of his causeless mercy was passing by…”

Parikshit Maharaj allowed Kali slaughterhouses, bars, brothels and casinos, none of which existed in his kingdom; so he granted a fifth place. Wherever gold is, the other four soon follow, because money can be used to sin. — “fifth place he said where the people hoard gold”

🎙 Prabhu at 10:30 (auto-transcript): “We find in the case of Kali, when Kali wanted to come, Pariksit Maharaj held him at the border. He said, you cannot come. Kali said, no, but the Lord wants me to come. Just like the will of the Lord was for the Yudhus to destroy themselves. So the same way the Lord willed for…”

children.topic: Cursed to be trees, then freed
children.note:
Narada curses them to become trees, but also blesses them: they will stand in Nanda Maharaja's courtyard and Krishna will free them. Bound to the mortar, Krishna fells the Yamala-arjuna trees only to keep His devotee's word.

🎙 Prabhu at 15:41 (auto-transcript): “so therefore Narada Muni, he was thinking yes, for these two boys I curse them to become poor and not just poor because they are standing naked and they don't even know that they are naked I'll curse them to become trees and so Narada Muni he cursed the two boys to become…”

Nimai opened a school at eleven. When the world-conquering scholar Digvijaya came to Navadvipa, the town's pandits, protecting their reputation, sent the child to debate him.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:02 (auto-transcript): “but Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu he teaches us what the real intoxication is when Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu was in Navadvipa, he would be teaching his students. At the age of 11, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu opened a school. In those days, it was possible. Nowadays, not so much. You need…”

Asked to glorify the Ganga, Digvijaya instantly composes a hundred verses. Nimai calls it good, 'but' — and points out five mistakes, stopping His students from laughing. Shaken, Digvijaya cannot sleep.

🎙 Prabhu at 20:45 (auto-transcript): “And so Digvijay Pandit, he came and he met Mahaprabhu, he met Nimai. and Nimai asked Digvijay Pandit, can you glorify Mother Ganga? And Digvijay Pandit immediately, as Mahaprabhu requested, immediately he composed 100 shlokas on Ganga. 100, immediately, like this, flowing…”

Feeling let down by his deity, he sees Saraswati in a dream. She says she cannot help him defeat the Supreme Lord and tells him not to be a fool but surrender. — “you were debating with my boss”

🎙 Prabhu at 23:20 (auto-transcript): “my worshippable deity mother Saraswati she has let me down she let me down and so at night Saraswati ma appeared in his dreams and she said do you know who you were debating with you were debating with my boss how can I help you defeat my boss I can't you have to be defeated…”

Next morning he runs to the school, not for a second round but to offer obeisances. Mahaprabhu stops his praise and tells him to chant the holy names.

🎙 Prabhu at 24:31 (auto-transcript): “and immediately the next morning as Mahaprabhu was there in his school Digvijay came running all the students said oh you want round two he said no no no no round two anymore right he came running and he immediately paid obeisances to Mahaprabhu he said I have surrendered…”

After His father's passing Nimai goes to Gaya, takes initiation from Ishvara Puri, and returns teaching only 'Krishna, Krishna' and 'gopi, gopi'.

🎙 Prabhu at 25:12 (auto-transcript): “So Mahaprabhu, he removed the intoxication of Digvijay. But then later on, Mahaprabhu's father left the earth and in order to do the funeral rites, he went to Gaya. Nimai went to Gaia to perform the final rites of the father and in Gaia he met Ishwara Puri, his spiritual…”

Students complain and Navadvipa gossips: He has become a drunkard, a ghost has him, or His stomach hurts. Worried, Saci Mata asks her neighbour Srivasa to check on her son.

🎙 Prabhu at 26:14 (auto-transcript): “around Navadip chanting Krishna Krishna and people of Navadip started thinking oh Nimai such a great scholar has now become a drunkard he's just roaming around the streets shouting Krishna Krishna he's become a drunkard some say no, no, he's not drunk. He's been possessed.…”

Srivasa finds Him in ecstasy; the Vaishnavas, who had worried He was lost in scholarship, rejoice. He tells Saci that her son's condition is what everyone wants, and soon the whole world will be like this. — “We also want to be intoxicated like this, with Krishna's names.”

🎙 Prabhu at 27:10 (auto-transcript): “neighbor, Srivast Prabhu. She asked him, please can you go and check on my son? Can you go and check on Mahaprabhu? Everyone is saying he is sick or he is intoxicated. Please can you go and check? Do we need to do something? So Srivast Prabhu said, okay fine, I will do that.…”

Mahaprabhu begins chanting through Navadvipa; Kaviraja Goswami says anyone who saw Him or heard the kirtan caught the intoxication — even animals chanted and danced.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:46 (auto-transcript): “And from that day onwards, Mahaprabhu started Nagar Sankirtan. He would go out in Navadip and chant. and Kaviraj Goswami mentions people would see Mahaprabhu just see him and they would also be imbibed with intoxication of Krishna's names anyone who would hear the Kirtan they…”

We too want to be intoxicated — not like the two brothers or pub crawlers, but by the holy name, which has no ill effects.

🎙 Prabhu at 29:19 (auto-transcript): “so we also want to be intoxicated but not intoxicated like Nala Kovara and Manigriva or intoxicated like ordinary people, the pub crawlers they call them, they crawl from one pub to another the whole night. No, we want to be intoxicated by the holy name of the Lord. Kaviraj…”

In Caitanya-caritamrita, Adi 9, Mahaprabhu wants help distributing the fruits of devotion and wishes to be the tree itself. Whoever tastes the fruit becomes mad like a drunkard — chanting, dancing, laughing and rolling on the ground.

🎙 Prabhu at 29:43 (auto-transcript): “by the holy name of the Lord. Kaviraj Goswami when he is describing the fruits of devotional service in chapter 9 of the Adi Leela of Chetar and Charita Amrita, he says Mahaprabhu is there and he's saying, I'm just a gardener. I'm distributing these fruits and I need help…”

Devotional service is joyful, so devotees sing, dance and roll — as drunkards do, except a drunkard does not know where or who he is. Mahaprabhu offers the real, positive intoxication.

🎙 Prabhu at 31:24 (auto-transcript): “So two opposites we see. Someone who is intoxicated also sings, also laughs, also rolls on the ground. But he doesn't know where he is rolling. Right? Or who he is. you hear all those stories of drunkards they don't know even where they are, who they are what they are doing…”

In Vrindavan a man rolled on the temple floor crying 'Krishna'. Srila Prabhupada told the devotees to approach with a stick; he ran, showing he was a sahajiya. Real lightness — jumping high as Mahaprabhu and early ISKCON devotees did — comes only from sincerely following the acharyas.

🎙 Prabhu at 32:55 (auto-transcript): “So this is not artificial. When the early disciples of Srila Prabhupada were in Vrindavan, then characters would come to the temple also. And one such character came and was rolling on the temple floors. And the devotees, they had only read about this. So they had not seen it…”

Rupa Goswami compares us to jaundice patients who taste the sweet names as bitter — one round feels long and sixteen impossible. The cure is to keep taking the sweet medicine until the taste returns. — “one has to take more and keep on taking more.”

🎙 Prabhu at 35:26 (auto-transcript): “then this intoxication naturally comes. Otherwise, what is the situation? Rupa Goswami explains in the neck of instruction, the names of Krishna are sweet, very sweet. But the practitioner in the beginning stages is afflicted with disease. And this disease is like jaundice.…”

Pure devotees aim to be absorbed in the name; mixed devotees like the demigods still cling to their positions. Indra, proud of ruling heaven, wanted to teach Krishna a lesson when Vraja worshipped Govardhana instead.

🎙 Prabhu at 39:32 (auto-transcript): “So, for pure devotees, that's the goal. For mixed devotees, like the demigods, they're goal waivers. Sometimes they want to be intoxicated with Krishna's names, but most of the time they still hold on to their positions. Like Indra Deva, he's intoxicated with his position. I…”

Indra sends floods far greater than recent ones in Nepal; Krishna lifts Govardhana, and Jiva Goswami says the Sudarshana circled the hill drying every drop. Indra comes with Surabhi for cover, and Krishna tells him to stick to his responsibility.

🎙 Prabhu at 41:13 (auto-transcript): “And he released what we just recently witnessed, the glacial floods in Nepal caused by a landslide. Indra Dev released a thousand times that on Vrindavan. And Lord Krishna, he just picked up the Govardhan hill, protected all his residents. Indra got tired. Jeeva Goswami…”

Within a few years Indra's pride grows again; when Krishna takes the parijata tree and the Sudharma hall, Indra fights Him once more. We should not feed intoxication in the opposite direction.

🎙 Prabhu at 42:57 (auto-transcript): “But see, Indra, his pride grew again. Although he was taught a lesson by Krishna in Vrindavan, when Lord Krishna was in Dwaraka, Indra decided again, no, I am going to fight with Krishna. Why? Because Krishna stole from Indra. He didn't technically steal because everything is…”

Feeding the other intoxications can pull us away from the holy name, so we need devotees around us who say: wrong direction.

🎙 Prabhu at 43:58 (auto-transcript): “Śrīla Prabhupāda, he mentions that I always wanted to be a big businessman. He said, I wanted big businessman, I have lots of money and then I can use that money for Krishna's service. But Krishna had other plans. And so Śrīla Prabhupāda's plan of being big businessman,…”

Srila Prabhupada wanted to become a big businessman and use the money for Krishna; it never worked, because Krishna wanted him to give the holy name to the world.

🎙 Prabhu at 43:58 (auto-transcript): “Śrīla Prabhupāda, he mentions that I always wanted to be a big businessman. He said, I wanted big businessman, I have lots of money and then I can use that money for Krishna's service. But Krishna had other plans. And so Śrīla Prabhupāda's plan of being big businessman,…”

Many devotees want plenty of Lakshmi to serve with. The danger: it is never enough, and without association pride can make us forget Krishna. Pray for the holy name alone; facilities come if He wishes. — “The goalpost keeps on moving, it's never enough.”

🎙 Prabhu at 45:07 (auto-transcript): “Many times, many devotees have that. Oh, we want to be well-situated, have lots of Lakshmi at our disposal, then we can use that for service of Krishna. But there can be a danger there. One, that we keep on accumulating, it's never enough. The goalpost keeps on moving, it's…”

King of the whole world, Ambarisha used his words to glorify the Lord and his opulence never touched him. It is possible — if we increase our intoxication in the name, the others get dealt with.

🎙 Prabhu at 46:11 (auto-transcript): “Just like Amrish Maharaj, great king of the entire world, he was intoxicated with the holy names of the Lord with devotional service but he was a king, he had so much opulence but that opulence never affected him it's mentioned, he used to use his words with his words he…”

Questions and comments after the class.

🎙 Prabhu at 47:24 (auto-transcript): “yes yeah yeah I can hear I'll repeat also on the mic for everyone else so I want you to help me understand the basis of karma so from what I understand is that living beings cannot escape death disease or age and death right and so there are people I know of that have lived a…”

A devotee asks whether people who live lavishly and die without suffering have less bad karma, or will pay later.

🎙 Prabhu at 47:24 (auto-transcript): “yes yeah yeah I can hear I'll repeat also on the mic for everyone else so I want you to help me understand the basis of karma so from what I understand is that living beings cannot escape death disease or age and death right and so there are people I know of that have lived a…”

High birth, wealth, education and beauty are the fruits of pious karma — four out of four, or fewer — and heavy sin brings their opposites.

🎙 Prabhu at 49:00 (auto-transcript): “right? So Kunti Maharani says yes these are the effects of good karma. Good karma produces four effects. High birth, opulence, education and beauty. Now someone who has done a lot of good karma gets all four out of four. Someone who has not done so much good karma but has…”

children.topic: What you do between birth and death
children.note:
Spending good karma on more sin binds one again; in Nairobi the poor eat meat only at weddings, the rich every day. Good karma is not enough — use it to come to Krishna consciousness, the seed that breaks the cycle. Narada made the brothers trees so they could sin no more.

🎙 Prabhu at 50:30 (auto-transcript): “But what in that time between the birth and the death, what did they do? That is what is important. If you have your results of good karma and you're spending them to create more sin, as we just discussed, when you have wealth, most of the time wealthy people eat more meat…”

Devotees live simply but want to get high on Krishna. Early devotees' 'stay high forever' poster drew LSD users; people on the streets asked what drug they were on, and many joined. — “We want to get high.”

🎙 Prabhu at 53:07 (auto-transcript): “we are not so much into oh we need to live a lavish lifestyle. No. Our motto, Srila Prabhupada taught us simple living, high thinking. We live simply, just enough to maintain the body but our thought is we want to be intoxicated in the names of Krishna. So the high thinking…”

How can a devotee with much wealth stay humble?

🎙 Prabhu at 54:38 (auto-transcript): “Yes, so how do we reconcile a devotee who has a lot of wealth and still remain humble? it's not easy for such a devotee that devotee has to be under constant”

children.topic: Tested twice, like a recovering alcoholic
children.note:
It is not easy; such a devotee needs constant guidance. Srila Prabhupada said Krishna tested him with forty rupees and then with Rolls Royces and palaces. Until intoxicated by the name, we must be careful like a recovering alcoholic and follow the rules with strong association.

🎙 Prabhu at 55:15 (auto-transcript): “it's not easy for such a devotee that devotee has to be under constant guidance from the spiritual master and other devotees because wealth is such a thing if we are not careful immediately we can go the wrong direction and so we find that Srila Prabhupada he said Krishna…”

Devotees recall Bhakti Caru Swami's words in this temple: the wealthy often give a fragment, but should give substantially; and money hoarded and not used for Krishna is the gold where Kali lives. Prabhu adds that wealth tends to make people more stingy.

🎙 Prabhu at 58:13 (auto-transcript): “Yes. So, Prabhu said that Bhakti Charo Maharaj here in this very temple, he mentioned that if someone is a wealthy person, they usually give a fragment of what they own for Krishna's service. But if actually they are wealthy, then they should give a sizable amount to spread…”

children.topic: Q3 · A shortcut in the shortcut?
children.note:
A devotee wants the quickest way to the intoxication of Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Prabhu at 60:00 (auto-transcript): “Firstly, I'd like to thank you for the very sobering us, and then these two points I wanted to make it was, I mean you actually put on one, and I was going to say that there's an idiom that's called money is a root of the earth, and it's very useful to the problem. And the…”

Come to Mahaprabhu and Lord Nityananda and never leave. The maha-mantra is already the shortcut, but until the disease is cured we must practise; Jagai and Madhai, without sixteen rounds, received initiation the same day by Nityananda's mercy.

🎙 Prabhu at 61:58 (auto-transcript): “Well, we have to come to Mahaprabhu. We have to catch hold of his feet. as Naratama Das Thakur says, Dharo Nitae Sukhai Pai. If you hold on to the feet of Lord Nityananda, we will get that intoxication. And so, you can come here, Jagannath Baldev Subhidramarani are there,…”

To attract Nityananda's mercy, save today's Jagais and Madhais. But if we are not strong, we become like them — so the safer path is sadhana bhakti as prescribed.

🎙 Prabhu at 64:02 (auto-transcript): “has mentioned, if you want to attract the mercy of Lord Nityananda, then what do you Well, you have to save the other Jagayas and Madayas and those are plenty, there are plenty as you mentioned, so many just out there. So if we go and we try and save them, then we can attract…”

nodeData.note: SB 1.3.43 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. Asked to speak on Srila Prabhupada, Prabhu starts from the verse calling the Bhagavatam a sun for the blind age of Kali, and shows Srila Prabhupada as the person Bhagavata who lived that vision. Through stories of Russia, Juhu, Shyamasundara's cigarette, the moon landing and the Kadamba garland, he shows how Srila Prabhupada saw the potential of places and people and saw Krishna face to face, and asks for loyalty to ISKCON, his body and the home he built for the whole world. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse calls the Bhagavatam a brilliant sun that rose after Krishna's departure for those blinded in Kali-yuga. The sages of Naimisharanya, led by Shaunaka, gathered to help the people of this age.

Asked to speak about Srila Prabhupada, Prabhu draws on notes from a lecture series Keshava Maharaja gave in Nairobi.

🎙 Prabhu at 07:14 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada today specifically and when Keshav Maharaj had visited Nairobi he had given a series of lectures on Śrīla Prabhupāda so I have made some notes from that series and that is what we will be discussing today. Śrīla Prabhupāda gave us the Bhagavatam and the verse…”

Short lives, quarrels over small things, laziness, misguided minds, bad luck and constant disturbance. Laziness shows in how work went from hands to computers to two thumbs on a phone. — “everyone works with fingers now”

🎙 Prabhu at 08:08 (auto-transcript): “will come in Kali Yuga, they will be at such a disadvantage. What did they see? they saw that the people who will come they'll have very short lives alpa ayusha you may have only met or even just heard about a few people who crossed 100 100 years is very long time but…”

Suta Goswami's answer is the Bhagavatam, which removes the darkness that hides who we are, why we are here and what to do. People absorbed in eating, sleeping, mating and defending live to eat instead of eating to live.

🎙 Prabhu at 10:17 (auto-transcript): “Sutra Goswami told them, the Srimad Bhagatam can drive away the darkness of Kali Yuga. When Kali Yuga came, there was a darkness that came with it. What is this darkness? The darkness that covers our knowledge of who we are. Why are we here? What are we supposed to be doing…”

A survey asked what people would do with free time: first sleep — especially on a cold, rainy day like this — then drink at the pub. Only devotees would say chant.

🎙 Prabhu at 11:10 (auto-transcript): “There was a survey done that if you had some free time, what would you do? If you had some free time, someone is shouting chant. But that wasn't part of the survey answers. right those only devotees would say they would chant so can anyone guess the first answer yes who said…”

The Bhagavatam is like a torch: it gives eyes to the blind.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:47 (auto-transcript): “But Bhagatam can give the light. It's like a torch. If you've seen our Back to Godhead magazines, the emblem of Back to Godhead is Vyasadev holding the Bhagatam up like this and there's light coming out from the Bhagatam and the people are there in the darkness and they're…”

The magazine's emblem shows Vyasadeva holding up the Bhagavatam with light streaming to people in darkness, and its motto 'Godhead is light' comes from this verse.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:51 (auto-transcript): “If you've seen our Back to Godhead magazines, the emblem of Back to Godhead is Vyasadev holding the Bhagatam up like this and there's light coming out from the Bhagatam and the people are there in the darkness and they're receiving this light. and the bhagatam's motto is…”

To understand the book Bhagavata we need the person Bhagavata, one who lives by it. The book restores our vision; the devotee shows how to live it.

🎙 Prabhu at 13:35 (auto-transcript): “the vision. Shri Prabhupada embodied the vision. There are two Bhagavatas. There is the book Bhagavat, this one here, and then there is the person Bhagavat. Both are needed. To understand the book Bhagavat, we need to go to a person Bhagavat, one who is living his life…”

Srila Prabhupada lived the Bhagavatam and embodied its vision. — “the walking Bhagavatam”

🎙 Prabhu at 14:06 (auto-transcript): “Shra Prabhupada lived his life in this manner. Shra Prabhupada was the walking Bhagavatam and he embodied this vision. It is not that there are no practitioners of bhakti outside of ISKCON or there are no devotees who understand the Bhagavatam outside of ISKCON or there are…”

There are practitioners and good speakers outside ISKCON, but it is Srila Prabhupada's commentary that transforms hearts. He took the Bhagavatam out of India, and other speakers now seek out ISKCON temples because that is where people listen.

🎙 Prabhu at 14:42 (auto-transcript): “of ISKCON. Oh, they are there. But it is Srila Prabhupada's Bhagatam commentary that is transforming hearts. We are all seated here today because of Srila Prabhupada. Srila Prabhupada brought the Bhagatam out of India and spread it all over the world. And all those who…”

Very sick in 1967, Srila Prabhupada said he might not return from India; a disciple suggested sending a Godbrother. He replied only that his Guru Maharaja was no ordinary master and had saved him. He saved us too, so our loyalty lies with him. — “That sense of loyalty is very, very important.”

🎙 Prabhu at 16:18 (auto-transcript): “Śrīla Prabhupāda was sick in 1967, very very sick in America and the disciples, they were worried. worried. So Srila Prabhupada said, I have to go back to India for treatment. And he was very sick. So he said, I may not come back. So the disciples, they were worried.…”

children.topic: We see the world as we are
children.note:
In Kali-yuga we have lost our vision and see the world through ourselves — a thief suspects everyone of theft.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:06 (auto-transcript): “In Kali Yuga, we've all lost our vision. We see the world as we see ourselves. Atmaman manyate jagat. If someone is a thief, he'll look at everyone and think they're also thieves. this is a known phenomenon someone is a thief he is always looking at others thinking this…”

A tourist sees a nice building and pictures; a contractor counts columns and checks the structure; a devotee sees the Lord waiting for us. The Bhagavatam, and those who live by it, teach us to see.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:39 (auto-transcript): “can mean different things so just like we have this beautiful temple if a tourist comes what do you think the tourist will see a tourist but who is not practicing devotional service because I am also a tourist what will a tourist see here beautiful yeah you'll see beautiful…”

Everyone said communist Russia behind the iron curtain was impossible. Srila Prabhupada went, met one person and planted a seed; today Russia has ISKCON's largest number of devotees outside India.

🎙 Prabhu at 20:35 (auto-transcript): “when Srila Prabhupada wanted to go to Russia people were saying oh Russia is an impossible place that time it was fully communist very strict immigration was strict border control was very strict everything was strict there it was known as the iron curtain there was no room…”

He came to Africa too — Kenya, then South Africa in 1975 — knowing everyone has the potential to become a devotee.

🎙 Prabhu at 21:38 (auto-transcript): “He even came here in Africa, first to Kenya and then to South Africa in 1975. Srila Prabhupada knew everyone has the potential to become a devotee. And so no place, no continent was untouched by Śrīla Prabhupāda this is how Śrīla Prabhupāda saw when he wanted to establish a…”

In Bombay he paid a deposit on bare bushland before any contract. Disciples doubted, but he installed Radha-Rasabihari under a tin roof with no walls, among rats and snakes.

🎙 Prabhu at 22:02 (auto-transcript): “when he wanted to establish a temple in Bombay now it's known as Mumbai but that time it was known as Bombay he found a place Juhu Beach there was a particular Mr. Shetty who helped Śrīla Prabhupāda get it from Mr. N, Mr. Nair I hope no one has the surname Nair here so Mr.…”

The owner found a richer buyer and sent hired thugs with sticks. Srila Prabhupada told the beaten devotees to defend themselves, refused to give up because he had promised the Deities a home there, and a municipal official helped. After the owner died his widow transferred the papers.

🎙 Prabhu at 23:48 (auto-transcript): “And then after some time, Mr. N thought, no, no, I'm getting a better buyer who's giving me more money. So these discont people, they can't have my land. And he told our devotees, you know, here's your 10%, get out of my land. He said, how can we get out? This we've bought.…”

Having seen Nairobi's round, cylindrical Hilton, he wanted the same; Juhu's guest house towers copy it. Land everyone called nowhere is now priceless, with celebrities living nearby.

🎙 Prabhu at 27:06 (auto-transcript): “and a lesser known fact when he came to Nairobi, he had seen the Hilton Hotel. So the Hilton Hotel in Nairobi is iconic. It's a cylinder that just comes out of the ground, round cylinder building. So when he saw that, he said, I want this in Juhu. And so if you go to Juhu,…”

He preached even in Tehran, in the heart of the Middle East, where there are devotees today.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:29 (auto-transcript): “has the potential. He even went to places like Tehran. We never imagined we go to a place like Tehran. But Śrīla Prabhupāda was preaching there in Tehran and there are devotees there in Tehran, right in the middle of the heart of Middle East. Right now is all bombs flying…”

He also saw what people could become, and empowered them.

🎙 Prabhu at 29:05 (auto-transcript): “He could see. Not only could he see the potential of places, but he could also see potential of people. When he went South America, he appointed one of his disciples Rameshwar as the GBC for South America. And Rameshwar Prabhu was thinking, there is nothing there. There are…”

children.topic: A GBC for an empty continent
children.note:
Ramesvara, made GBC for South America, wondered what to do with no devotees or temples; within two years South America led ISKCON in book distribution.

🎙 Prabhu at 29:10 (auto-transcript): “of people. When he went South America, he appointed one of his disciples Rameshwar as the GBC for South America. And Rameshwar Prabhu was thinking, there is nothing there. There are no devotees, there are no temples, and I've been GBC, what am I going to do? But Srila…”

The uninitiated carpenter carving large Jagannatha deities kept a cigarette pack on Jagannatha's head. Srila Prabhupada flicked it off with his cane and gently told him to cut down step by step — and he stopped. — “If you are doing 10, do 9.”

🎙 Prabhu at 30:02 (auto-transcript): “Jagannath Baldev Subhadramayi in San Francisco and that time he had one disciple called Shamsundar. So the Jagannath he got were very small, like this big. So he asked Shamsundar because Shamsundar was a carpenter and he asked him, can you make times 10 of this? And he said,…”

In Nairobi, boys told to dress nicely put on Srila Prabhupada's drying cloth and sat in front of him. He calmly said wash it and bring it back tomorrow — such compassion.

🎙 Prabhu at 31:39 (auto-transcript): “and he stopped Shala Prabhupada also came to Nairobi and his disciples had washed his cloth and put it to dry and the next part of the day Shala Prabhupada was supposed to lecture and so the devotees there told the guests who had come there were some boys there they told them…”

On a New York park bench in 1965 he told a stranger about his many disciples, temples and books in an international society that did not yet exist. He saw it already; he was only an instrument, and wants us to be instruments too. — “only time is separating.”

🎙 Prabhu at 33:35 (auto-transcript): “he used to sit in the bank on a bench in the new york city park and one person came and he said oh are you from india i said yes oh what are you doing here he's like oh i'm preaching spreading the message of Krishna, teaching Bhagat Gita. Oh, and you are alone? He said, no,…”

He could also see that what everyone accepted as true was not.

🎙 Prabhu at 35:28 (auto-transcript): “This is the immense gift Śrīla Prabhupāda has given us, not only could he see potential of people, he could also see that which is not true, which everyone else is accepting true. So in 1969, there was a moon landing. It was a big thing. Everyone was saying, oh Prabhupāda, we…”

Prabhu recounts Srila Prabhupada denying the 1969 moon landing when disciples showed him the TV, and saying that whoever believes he came from a monkey is still a monkey.

🎙 Prabhu at 35:37 (auto-transcript): “that which is not true, which everyone else is accepting true. So in 1969, there was a moon landing. It was a big thing. Everyone was saying, oh Prabhupāda, we have touched the moon, we have landed on the moon. Śrīla Prabhupāda said, no, you have no idea. That's not the moon.…”

A man with factories, houses and money said he was not happy. Srila Prabhupada said more desires mean more anxiety: give it all to us and you will be happy. The man was not convinced.

🎙 Prabhu at 36:50 (auto-transcript): “One time an industrialist came to Srila Prabhupada. Srila Prabhupada, I have so many factories. And in each factory I have so many workers. I have so many houses also. I have so much money. Srila Prabhupada, I am still not happy. So, Srila Prabhupada said, Yes, more material…”

To a hippie asking about the spiritual world he said it is like an ocean of LSD — preaching in terms people could understand.

🎙 Prabhu at 37:39 (auto-transcript): “One time a hippie asked him, Śrīla Prabhupāda, what is the spiritual world like? This is a hippie, that time in America, the youth, they were all drowning in drugs and counter-culture or anti-culture, they would call it. Śrīla Prabhupāda replied, it's like an ocean of LSD.…”

Srila Prabhupada said the Bhagavatam was going to America and he was only accompanying it: three trunks of books, forty rupees and two dhotis.

🎙 Prabhu at 38:19 (auto-transcript): “and what did he go with to America he went with the Bhagatam Srila Prabhupada often said I am not going to America Bhagatam is going to America I am accompanying the Bhagatam when he reached the shores of Boston he had three trunk full of Bhagatam and only 40 rupees in his…”

Asked by a reporter where his translations come from, he said Krishna tells him; when Ramesvara tried to soften it as revelation, he insisted — face to face. He read his own books because Krishna dictated them.

🎙 Prabhu at 39:09 (auto-transcript): “that everyone should have the ability to see krishna one time a reporter asked silla prabhapad so how do you translate all these books and where do you get everything from silla prabhapad said Krishna tells me. The reporter looked at Srila Prabhupada and the disciples were…”

An early disciple in Jhansi found him chanting and dancing at midnight wearing a fragrant Kadamba garland no one had brought. He spoke confidently about Krishna because he could see Him.

🎙 Prabhu at 40:42 (auto-transcript): “there is also one account of his early disciple Prabhakar he found Krishna Srila Prabhupada in Jansi in the middle of the night Srila Prabhupada was chanting and dancing and he had a garland, Kadamba flower garland, big Kadambas. And the disciples wondering, there are no…”

With scripture as our eyes and Srila Prabhupada's footsteps, the goal is to see Krishna face to face. Some answer 'maybe not today', but what is good should be done now; it is the most urgent work.

🎙 Prabhu at 42:23 (auto-transcript): “to see Krishna face to face how many want to see Krishna face to face? some people are like maybe not today maybe a little while later isn't it? no there is a sense of urgency we should not even say in Sanskrit they say what is meant to be done and is good and is auspicious…”

On the Jaladuta he had two heart attacks with no doctor or medicine — unlike Prabhu's friend who panicked over flu in Mayapur. His diary says Caitanya-caritamrita was his joyful companion.

🎙 Prabhu at 43:33 (auto-transcript): “how Krishna was with him at every step when he was on board Jaladuta he suffered two heart attacks on the ship two heart attacks no medical facilities no doctors no medicine nobody to make you good food nothing Ordinary people can't do that. We go to a place, we first find…”

He showed by example that the Bhagavatam's path can be lived. Understanding what he did should multiply our loyalty.

🎙 Prabhu at 45:42 (auto-transcript): “He showed that this path that is spoken of in the Bhagavatam can be lived. By his own personal example, he was living it. So he showed this path can be lived. And that's all he wants from us. One time a reporter asked him, Srila Prabhupada, why have you come to London? I…”

Asked by a reporter why he came, he said the British took everything from India but forgot Krishna consciousness, so he had come to give it. Asked about grey, colourless London, he called it hellish.

🎙 Prabhu at 45:57 (auto-transcript): “One time a reporter asked him, Srila Prabhupada, why have you come to London? I think it was in London. And Srila Prabhupada said, the Britishers came to India. They took everything. But they forgot one thing. that's the thing I've come to give and the reporter was like oh…”

We do not throw away a head that aches or a leg that hurts; we learn to deal with it. ISKCON is Srila Prabhupada's body, so we do not waver from it. — “Do you get rid of your head?”

🎙 Prabhu at 47:25 (auto-transcript): “Śrīla Prabhupāda said Iskhan is my body so whatever it is if you have a headache in your head Do you get rid of your head? Oh, this head is giving me too much pain. Let me just throw it away. No. Or the arm or the leg is giving some issue. Do we cut it off or throw it away?…”

At Gaura Purnima in Mayapur over 200 nationalities chant together. With tilak, dhoti and kanthi-mala you can walk into any ISKCON temple and be home. — “That's the real United Nations.”

🎙 Prabhu at 48:30 (auto-transcript): “Ordinarily, it's impossible. But recently when in Mayapur, during Gorpunima, they always do this survey. So they asked at the beginning of the festival, how many nationalities were present there in that festival? They had 200 plus nationalities. That's the real United…”

He believes in us to spread his movement. Whatever our role, we can make people feel welcome in his home — if we cannot bring anyone, let us not chase away those who have come. — “let us not chase anyone”

🎙 Prabhu at 49:30 (auto-transcript): “so let us meditate on this wonderful gift that Śrīla Prabhupāda has given us the gift of Krishna consciousness the belief he has in us to spread his movement to everybody and our own role however big or not so big it may be in making others feel welcome in Śrīla Prabhupāda's…”

maps.title: SB classes 2026 · Class 09 · Krishna Eats One Grain

nodeData.note: SB 1.15.11 · a class by HG Sri Gauranga Das. Arjuna, grieving Krishna's departure, remembers how the Lord saved the Pandavas when Duryodhana sent Durvasa and his ten thousand disciples to them in exile after Draupadi had eaten. Prabhu tells the story of the akshaya-patra, the single grain Krishna ate, and other Durvasa episodes, then shows how the Pandavas were never separate from Krishna because they thought only of pleasing Him — and how we can make Krishna dearest again by serving Him with the tongue. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Arjuna recalls how Krishna rescued the Pandavas when Durvasa came with his disciples during their exile, and how one bit of food Krishna ate satisfied everyone.

Met with Yudhishthira's volley of questions at Hastinapura, Arjuna is lost for words; with heavy breathing he finally says Krishna has left this earth.

🎙 Prabhu at 08:57 (auto-transcript): “he didn't know what to say and then eventually with heavy breathing Arjuna broke the news to Yudhishthir Maharaj that Lord Krishna is no longer present on this earth that he has left them alone and so we find that Arjuna is recollecting All the various times that Lord Krishna…”

He has been recounting each rescue: Draupadi in the assembly, the defeat of Jarasandha, conquering Indra while protecting Maya Danava, helping Agni consume the Khandava forest, and winning Draupadi's hand.

🎙 Prabhu at 09:30 (auto-transcript): “All the various times that Lord Krishna saved them In yesterday's verse He mentioned that How Lord Krishna saved Draupadi In the vicious assembly How Lord Krishna in the previous verses He also mentions that How he saved them from Jarasand Who was such a big king With so much…”

After losing the dice game the Pandavas were exiled for twelve years plus one year incognito; if discovered, another twelve years.

🎙 Prabhu at 11:12 (auto-transcript): “when the Pandavas lost the dice match they were exiled for 12 years into the forest with one year additional to be incognito and if they were caught in that one year where they are supposed to hide they were supposed to live incognito if they were found out then they would…”

Brahmanas and guests followed them into the forest, and Yudhishthira worried how to feed them with only roots and fruits. He asked the family priest Dhaumya for a solution.

🎙 Prabhu at 11:48 (auto-transcript): “The Pandavas were exiled to the forest but when the Pandavas proceeded to the forest then along with them many brahmanas also went and other guests also went and Yudhishthir Maharaj was very worried because he is travelling with this entourage and they were in the forest. No…”

Dhaumya advised approaching the sun-god, who is in charge of food. Yudhishthira stood in the water chanting Surya's names for many days until he appeared and gave a copper vessel that never runs out.

🎙 Prabhu at 12:55 (auto-transcript): “so Dhomya he suggested to Yudhishthir Maharaj he said my dear king please let us approach the sun god Suryadev he feeds everyone he is in charge of food so please let us approach Suryadev and Yudhishthir Maharaj asked what is it that he needs to do the process of getting…”

Guests must be fed first, and once Draupadi has eaten the vessel stops until the next day. — “make sure Draupadi is the last one to eat”

🎙 Prabhu at 15:03 (auto-transcript): “But There are two conditions One that you have to feed the guests first then you eat and number two after Draupadi has eaten that vessel will stop producing food until the next day so make sure Draupadi is the last one to eat and so Yudhishya Maharaj having received this gift…”

Hearing of the vessel, Duryodhana wanted it stopped. He knew Durvasa, an expansion of Lord Shiva, is easy to please and quick to anger.

🎙 Prabhu at 16:14 (auto-transcript): “so Mahabharat mentions Duryodhan He had known about Durvasamuni As we read in the paper Durvasamuni He is very easy to please And also very quick to anger Because he is a Representation Or an expansion of Lord Shiva When Atrimuni Was praying To the supreme creator He did not…”

Atri prayed to 'the controller' without saying which, and Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva all came. His wife Anasuya fed them and asked for sons like them: Soma from Brahma, Durvasa from Shiva and Dattatreya from Vishnu.

🎙 Prabhu at 16:43 (auto-transcript): “When Atrimuni Was praying To the supreme creator He did not specify Who he wanted to come there he was talking about the controller he didn't say supreme controller he said I want to have audience with the controller and so three people came there Lord Brahma, Lord Vishnu and…”

Duryodhana invited Durvasa and his ten thousand disciples to accept his service.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:25 (auto-transcript): “So Duryodhana knew Durvasa Muni can be pleased very easily and can also be very quick to anger. So he sent an invitation to Durvasamuni, please come and accept our service. And Duryodhana made sure everything was perfect. All the arrangements, the reception, the feeding, he…”

He made sure no one made the slightest mistake in reception or feeding, and the pleased sage offered a blessing.

🎙 Prabhu at 18:41 (auto-transcript): “And Duryodhana made sure everything was perfect. All the arrangements, the reception, the feeding, he made sure nobody anywhere made a mistake to displease Durvasamuni. And so after the whole feeding program and everything was over, Durvasamuni was there with his 10,000…”

Feigning sadness, he asked Durvasa to visit his worshipable eldest brother in the forest — but in the evening, after the Pandavas and Draupadi had eaten, so there would be no food and the sage would curse them.

🎙 Prabhu at 19:30 (auto-transcript): “want and Duryodhana said no I am just so happy you accepted my invitation you came and ate with us here this pleased me very much but I am little sad. Duryodhana said why are you sad? See you've blessed me and you've blessed our palace but I have cousins and he is our eldest.…”

He served great sages so nicely, yet because his intention was to destroy his cousins he never received any real blessing. — “Look at the mentality of Duryodhana.”

🎙 Prabhu at 21:30 (auto-transcript): “Look at the mentality of Duryodhana. He is calling a sage, he is inviting so nicely, he is feeding so nicely but the motive behind was, I want to destroy my cousin. So although Duryodhana served such great sages, but because the intention of Duryodhana was not proper,…”

Yudhishthira bought time by sending the sages to bathe; Draupadi found the vessel closed for the day and began meditating on Krishna, who at once knocked on the door.

🎙 Prabhu at 22:24 (auto-transcript): “And so when Durvasamuni came to Yudhishthir Maharaj in the forest, Yudhishthira Maharaj welcomed Durvasamuni very nicely. And Durvasamuni said, yes, I have come here and we would like to eat. Yudhishthira Maharaj, he wanted to buy some time because now they were in a…”

Krishna asks for food; Draupadi asks why He is adding to their trouble when they cannot even feed Durvasa. He asks to see the vessel.

🎙 Prabhu at 23:35 (auto-transcript): “Lord Krishna knocked on the door and then they welcomed him and Lord Krishna said ok everything else aside I am very hungry give me some food and Draupadi she looked at Lord Krishna and Lord Krishna said why are you looking? give some food I am hungry give me something to eat…”

Her tears were not about Durvasa's anger but that Krishna had asked her for something and she could not give it. — “this is the caliber of devotees”

🎙 Prabhu at 24:31 (auto-transcript): “Drupadi was crying As Prabhupada is mentioning Lord Krishna asked her for food and she couldn't give she wasn't so worried about what Durvasa will do she was worried Krishna has asked me for something and I can't give it this is the caliber of devotees the Pandavas wa and so…”

On the inside rim Krishna finds a grain of rice stuck to a bit of green vegetable. Draupadi is ashamed she did not even clean the pot; some acharyas say she asked Him to feed Himself with half and everyone with the other half. He eats it and says He is satisfied.

🎙 Prabhu at 24:52 (auto-transcript): “and so she brought the pot the Akshay Patra to Lord Krishna and Lord Krishna was inspecting the Akshay Patra and on the edge it had a rim so in the inside rim it's mentioned here Arjuna is saying shakha anna, shakha means green leafy vegetable and anna means grain. So there…”

In the river the sages start burping. Bhima, with full faith, goes to call them though there is no food; the disciples fear they will burst, and Durvasa sends apologies and leaves.

🎙 Prabhu at 26:10 (auto-transcript): “and on the flip side Durvasamuni and 10,000 disciples suddenly they started burping they were burping so much in the river and Lord Krishna on this side told Bhima please go call go call Durvasa and his disciples so Bhima looked at Krishna and like there is no food I am going…”

Prabhu tells other episodes showing both sides of Durvasa.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:15 (auto-transcript): “Durvasa Muni he is known easily angered and easily pleased easily angered Shala Prabhupada is referring to Amrish Maharaj. We all know the story. Amrish Maharaj broke his fast and didn't break his fast at the same time. But Durvasa got angry and he produced a demon that was…”

Angry with Ambarisha over breaking his fast, Durvasa created a demon to kill him; the Lord's Sudarshana destroyed it and chased Durvasa.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:28 (auto-transcript): “Shala Prabhupada is referring to Amrish Maharaj. We all know the story. Amrish Maharaj broke his fast and didn't break his fast at the same time. But Durvasa got angry and he produced a demon that was going to kill Amrish Maharaj. But the Lord protected Amrish Maharaj also by…”

Durvasa gave Indra a fine garland; Indra put it on Airavata, who threw it down and stepped on it. Durvasa cursed the proud demigods to lose everything — Bali took the heavens until Aditi prayed and Vamanadeva restored them.

🎙 Prabhu at 28:57 (auto-transcript): “Another time Durvasa went to the heavenly planets and there he saw lord indra and durvasa was wearing a very nice garland so he said oh this garland is nice garland i should give it to the king of the demigods indra and so durvasa gave his garland to indra but indra instead…”

Per the Garga Samhita, pleased with Radharani's cooking, Durvasa blessed her: no one will cook as well, and whoever eats her cooking will live long and healthy. Yashoda, worried about demons, asked that she cook for Krishna daily; acharyas say she never repeats a preparation.

🎙 Prabhu at 30:44 (auto-transcript): “Garga Samitha mentions Durvasa once went to Vraja and he went to the house of Kirtida and Rishabhanu and there Srimati Radharani was there and she was the one told cook for Durvasa so Srimati Radharani cooked and gave it to Durvasa Durvasa ate he was so happy with the prasad…”

Prabhu notes some accounts are folklore rather than shastra: Durvasa, stuck in a river after losing his cloth, was helped by Draupadi with a torn piece of her sari and blessed her with unlimited cloth when needed — linked by some to her rescue in the assembly.

🎙 Prabhu at 33:42 (auto-transcript): “Durvasamuni there are many instances some are not so verified or in the shastra but folklore and traditional accounts they say they are associated with Durvasamuni one such incident is that Durvasa Muni was bathing in the river and somehow he was left without his kopins. The…”

Arjuna feels orphaned, yet even without Krishna's physical presence he is fully Krishna conscious, absorbed in how the Lord saved them.

🎙 Prabhu at 35:37 (auto-transcript): “However, here what Arjuna is recollecting is that not just with Durvasa, with all the incidences in their life, Lord Krishna always protected them. And so Arjuna is now feeling that our shelter, our protector is no longer there. We are left, abandoned, orphaned, without…”

children.topic: Please Him and all are pleased
children.note:
The Pandavas knew Krishna is the root of the world and enjoyer of all sacrifices, so their only concern was pleasing Him; trials barely touched them.

🎙 Prabhu at 36:53 (auto-transcript): “conscious and so they knew if we satisfy the Lord then everyone is satisfied. Just mean to stay Jagat Tuhtam. Lord Krishna he is the enjoyer of all sacrifices and austerities he is the supreme lord of all planets and demigods and so they knew if we please Lord Krishna then…”

As kings they fed so many out of duty, because common people follow great ones. They never worried — the moment Durvasa went to bathe, they called Krishna, and He came.

🎙 Prabhu at 38:19 (auto-transcript): “but as a duty and as to set an example because they were kings whatever great people do common men follow so Yudhishthir Maharaj out of his duty he was obliged to feed so many people and out of that obligation they got the Akshay Patra and this whole incidence was playing…”
Krishna says one who sees Him everywhere is never lost to Him, nor He to that person. Only devotees can understand how dear the Lord and His devotees are to each other.

Krishna sent Akrura to see how His cousins were treated; Akrura warned Dhritarashtra that the Pandavas had Krishna. Unheeded, the schemes went on, but Krishna protected them through all of it.

🎙 Prabhu at 41:04 (auto-transcript): “Were very very dear to the Lord He even sent Ankara to Hastinapur To check on them He sent Ankara and he told Ankara please go and see how my cousins are doing. And when Akrura saw the mistreatment that they were being exposed to from Dhritarashtra, he told Dhritarashtra…”

We are already dear to Krishna; we have forgotten how dear He is to us, and devotional service revives it.

🎙 Prabhu at 42:01 (auto-transcript): “Our focus is how can we become in that position that Lord Krishna is the most dear to us. We are already dear to Krishna. We have forgotten how dear Krishna is to us. And so through the process of devotional service, we can revive this relationship again and make Lord Krishna…”

People guard their phones at all costs and, when one is lost, end up like Arjuna, unable to function. Bhakti removes false objects of love — friends, family, possessions, even the body. — “Nowadays, the most dear thing is the mobile phone.”

🎙 Prabhu at 42:36 (auto-transcript): “Everyone holds so many things dear to them. Nowadays, the most dear thing is the mobile phone. We have to protect it at all costs. When a mobile phone is lost, people come into this position of Arjuna. They don't know how to function, they don't know what to do. But through…”

Srila Prabhupada explains we love the body because we sit in it, and we are part of Krishna — so all our love is really love for Him.

🎙 Prabhu at 43:25 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada gave this explanation that we love other objects because of our love for Krishna. if we analyze everything even this body we love this body because we are here seated in the body and who are we if one meditates in this way I love this body because I am seated…”

Service attracts Krishna; when the tongue serves Him He reveals Himself. Two ways: eat only Krishna prasadam and chant His names.

🎙 Prabhu at 44:40 (auto-transcript): “The way to attract Lord Krishna is through service Right now we have so many dear objects Sarvopadi These are all upadi's designations But when we render service on to Lord Krishna With our tongue Then Lord Krishna reveals himself And he becomes very dear to us How do we…”

A question after the class.

🎙 Prabhu at 45:56 (auto-transcript): “The question is, there are devotees who go to eat at people's houses. So are these other people devotees or are they just members of the public? So is there a lesson for devotees going to eat at other people's houses? Devotees don't eat at other people's houses. They eat at…”

Is there a lesson for devotees who go to eat at people's houses?

🎙 Prabhu at 45:56 (auto-transcript): “The question is, there are devotees who go to eat at people's houses. So are these other people devotees or are they just members of the public? So is there a lesson for devotees going to eat at other people's houses? Devotees don't eat at other people's houses. They eat at…”

Devotees eat at devotees' homes as a loving exchange. Krishna declined Duryodhana's opulent feast, and Rupa Goswami describes the exchange of inviting and being invited by those who are affectionate. — “I don't go to places where there is no love.”

🎙 Prabhu at 46:25 (auto-transcript): “Devotees don't eat at other people's houses. They eat at devotees' houses. That's part of the loving exchange. The devotees, they invite other devotees to their houses to feed them And they also accept invitation at other devotees' houses for eating The mood should be, we are…”

Not going to an industrialist's house just to satisfy the tongue; avoid overeating, as Mahaprabhu warns, and take only Krishna prasadam.

🎙 Prabhu at 47:43 (auto-transcript): “But not that, oh, we will go and eat at some big industrialist place because, you know, we have our tongue that needs to be satisfied. No. Devotees have to be very careful atyahara, over eating. And also, Mahaprabhu says, we have to be careful what we eat. So therefore, we…”
